paragraphs.text: "导航个屁，老子十年前就在这条路上飙自行车了。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{8693EB5B-3129-40CE-A582-A684838C6FF3}{214}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["导航个屁，老子十年前就在这条路上飙自行车了。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{8693EB5B-3129-40CE-A582-A684838C6FF3}{216}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一方向盘打得飞起，奥德赛的车头几乎是贴着墙角的垃圾箱划过去的。后视镜里能听到环卫工大爷骂骂咧咧的声音。

paragraphs.text: "这叫战术。"

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{10}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "那叫资源整合。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{16}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["那叫资源整合。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{18}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智往座椅里缩了缩，奥德赛的座椅是真的舒服，像是被一双手托着一样。暖风呼呼地从出风口灌进来，把他鼻尖上的一点寒气都吹散了。窗外建设路上的霓虹灯一盏接一盏地划过，在他的脸上画出一片一片的色彩。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{20}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智往座椅里缩了缩，奥德赛的座椅是真的舒服，像是被一双手托着一样。暖风呼呼地从出风口灌进来，把他鼻尖上的一点寒气都吹散了。窗外建设路上的霓虹灯一盏接一盏地划过，在他的脸上画出一片一片的色彩。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{22}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 东风街跑到底再左拐，混进建设路的车流里，那台86就再也追不上了。侯天一这才把脚从油门上松了松，转速表指针乖乖地落回了2000转。

paragraphs.text: "哥，你什么时候学的这一套啊？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{28}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哥，你什么时候学的这一套啊？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{30}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哪一套？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{32}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哪一套？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{34}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "钻胡同走小路那一套。我看你刚才那个过弯速度，我光坐着都觉得要翻。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{36}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["钻胡同走小路那一套。我看你刚才那个过弯速度，我光坐着都觉得要翻。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{38}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "切，藤原拓海那可是闭着眼睛过五连发夹弯的人，我这算什么。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{40}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["切，藤原拓海那可是闭着眼睛过五连发夹弯的人，我这算什么。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{42}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "人家那是AE86。"

paragraphs.text: "奥德赛怎么了，奥德赛也能跑。"

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{50}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "得了吧哥，你这就是一台奥德赛，刚才那一脚油门顶多算个热身。"

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{54}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没有说话，伸手把小智手里剩下的那半杯冰美式拿过来又喝了一口。

paragraphs.text: "哎，那是我的。"

paragraphs.text: "哥，咱们这是去哪儿啊？"

paragraphs.text: "回哪个家？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{84}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["回哪个家？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{86}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "回咱妈那儿。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{88}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["回咱妈那儿。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{90}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "啥？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{92}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["啥？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{94}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "大伯二伯今晚都在那儿，妈让我把你带过去吃年夜饭。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{96}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["大伯二伯今晚都在那儿，妈让我把你带过去吃年夜饭。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{98}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "我操，你怎么不早说！"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{100}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["我操，你怎么不早说！"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{102}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "你也没问啊。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{104}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["你也没问啊。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{106}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "我现在这样怎么去见大伯二伯啊，裤子上一片咖啡渍，头发也乱七八糟……"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{108}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["我现在这样怎么去见大伯二伯啊，裤子上一片咖啡渍，头发也乱七八糟……"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{110}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "没事，他们都说今年流行脏脏的。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{112}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["没事，他们都说今年流行脏脏的。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{114}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "滚你的。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{116}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["滚你的。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{118}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛驶进了城东的老小区。路灯昏昏沉沉的，路边的积雪被扫到了两边，露出底下湿漉漉的水泥地。远处三楼的窗户里透出一片暖黄色的光。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{120}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛驶进了城东的老小区。路灯昏昏沉沉的，路边的积雪被扫到了两边，露出底下湿漉漉的水泥地。远处三楼的窗户里透出一片暖黄色的光。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{122}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一熄了火，发动机轻轻地叹了口气。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{124}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一熄了火，发动机轻轻地叹了口气。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{126}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "走吧小智，妈在楼上等咱们呢。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{128}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["走吧小智，妈在楼上等咱们呢。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "等等哥，你手里那杯咖啡。"

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{190}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 两个人从车里钻出来，锁车的喇叭响了一声。楼道里的声控灯被说话声激亮，又在关门声中熄灭。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{192}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[两个人从车里钻出来，锁车的喇叭响了一声。楼道里的声控灯被说话声激亮，又在关门声中熄灭。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{194}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 三楼楼梯口，一双布鞋已经在那里等着了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{196}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[三楼楼梯口，一双布鞋已经在那里等着了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{198}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "回来了？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{200}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["回来了？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{202}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "回来了妈。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{204}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["回来了妈。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{206}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "小智也来了？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{208}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["小智也来了？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{210}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "婶儿好！"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{212}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["婶儿好！"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{214}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哎，长高了。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{216}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哎，长高了。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{218}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智嘿嘿一笑，咖啡渍在裤腿上晃了晃，跟着侯天一一起钻进了那扇透着暖光的门。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{220}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智嘿嘿一笑，咖啡渍在裤腿上晃了晃，跟着侯天一一起钻进了那扇透着暖光的门。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{222}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 屋里传来大伯二伯搓麻将的声音。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:44:44.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{224}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[屋里传来大伯二伯搓麻将的声音。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: GLM 5.3 high
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: GLM 5.3 high]]>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-12T21:03:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{242}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 绿灯亮起的一瞬，侯天一先把那杯瑰夏塞回小智怀里。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{245}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯亮起的一瞬，侯天一先把那杯瑰夏塞回小智怀里。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “端好了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{247}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“端好了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 下一秒，奥德赛蹿了出去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{249}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[下一秒，奥德赛蹿了出去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: CVT这东西没有换挡间隙，油门给到一半，转速直拉三千，整台车一气呵成滑过了斑马线。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{251}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[CVT这东西没有换挡间隙，油门给到一半，转速直拉三千，整台车一气呵成滑过了斑马线。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 推背感这东西，奥德赛也有，就那么一小下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{253}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[推背感这东西，奥德赛也有，就那么一小下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智的后背结结实实撞进椅背，杯里的瑰夏顺着吸管口滋出来几滴，全落在裤子上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{39FAAEBE-079E-4095-9C27-90D0B41974EC}{255}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智的后背结结实实撞进椅背，杯里的瑰夏顺着吸管口滋出来几滴，全落在裤子上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “卧槽！咖啡！哥！我咖啡！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{11}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“卧槽！咖啡！哥！我咖啡！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “自找的，让你端好。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{13}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“自找的，让你端好。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 旁边那条车道的粉86就乱了套。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{15}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[旁边那条车道的粉86就乱了套。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 起步之前转速早就顶了上去，绿灯亮起的刹那，离合松开。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{17}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[起步之前转速早就顶了上去，绿灯亮起的刹那，离合松开。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 后轮在这个飘雪的夜里直接出卖了它。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{19}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[后轮在这个飘雪的夜里直接出卖了它。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “昂昂昂！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{21}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“昂昂昂！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 半热熔在低温柏油上疯狂空转，车尾猛地向左一甩，车头一歪，直指对向车道。对向正有辆出租车拐过来，远光灯闪了两下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{23}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[半热熔在低温柏油上疯狂空转，车尾猛地向左一甩，车头一歪，直指对向车道。对向正有辆出租车拐过来，远光灯闪了两下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车主慌忙收油回盘，等轮胎重新咬住地面，两秒已经没了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{25}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车主慌忙收油回盘，等轮胎重新咬住地面，两秒已经没了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛越过了整个路口。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{27}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛越过了整个路口。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智扒着车窗回头看，笑得直拍大腿。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{29}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智扒着车窗回头看，笑得直拍大腿。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哈哈哈哈操！打滑了！哥！他打滑了！你刚说的那胎！那傻X的胎！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{31}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哈哈哈哈操！打滑了！哥！他打滑了！你刚说的那胎！那傻X的胎！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{33}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“嗯。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一手很稳，油门只给了一半多一点。雨刮器还在吱吱地刮着玻璃水。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{35}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一手很稳，油门只给了一半多一点。雨刮器还在吱吱地刮着玻璃水。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: DejaVu的人声炸了进来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{37}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[DejaVu的人声炸了进来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “踹出给所！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{39}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“踹出给所！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86缓过劲之后开始疯狂回追。二挡拉到六千转，声浪一层压着一层，三个车身的差距瞬间被吃掉一个。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{41}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86缓过劲之后开始疯狂回追。二挡拉到六千转，声浪一层压着一层，三个车身的差距瞬间被吃掉一个。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 毕竟二百多匹对一百多匹，毕竟双门跑车对七座奶爸车。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{43}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[毕竟二百多匹对一百多匹，毕竟双门跑车对七座奶爸车。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥！他咬上来了！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{45}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥！他咬上来了！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “让他咬。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{47}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“让他咬。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 前方五百米，下一个路口的读秒灯跳红了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{49}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[前方五百米，下一个路口的读秒灯跳红了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86从右侧强行并线。超车那一秒，副驾驶的黑丝小姐姐又一次摇下车窗，中指给得干脆利落。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{51}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86从右侧强行并线。超车那一秒，副驾驶的黑丝小姐姐又一次摇下车窗，中指给得干脆利落。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智当场炸毛，半个身子都探了过来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{53}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智当场炸毛，半个身子都探了过来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥！又是那个手势！这娘们儿属什么的！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{55}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥！又是那个手势！这娘们儿属什么的！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “坐好，看前面。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{57}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“坐好，看前面。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一的声音很平。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{59}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一的声音很平。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86并线之后，时速还有六十码往上。雪天的路面，低温的半热熔，前方三十米就是停止线。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{61}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86并线之后，时速还有六十码往上。雪天的路面，低温的半热熔，前方三十米就是停止线。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “吱嘎！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{63}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“吱嘎！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 刹车声一下子蹿了起来，尖得扎耳朵。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{65}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[刹车声一下子蹿了起来，尖得扎耳朵。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: ABS疯狂点头，车身一抖一抖朝停止线蹭，车头在薄雪上拖出一道歪歪扭扭的印子。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{67}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[ABS疯狂点头，车身一抖一抖朝停止线蹭，车头在薄雪上拖出一道歪歪扭扭的印子。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 停稳的时候，整个车头探出停止线两米开外。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{69}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[停稳的时候，整个车头探出停止线两米开外。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛稳稳滑进它左后方的车道。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{71}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛稳稳滑进它左后方的车道。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智已经殷勤地摸出一根白将军递到了嘴边。火苗一跳，烟气顺着暖风淌进车厢。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{73}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智已经殷勤地摸出一根白将军递到了嘴边。火苗一跳，烟气顺着暖风淌进车厢。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一摇下车窗。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{75}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一摇下车窗。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哎，兄弟。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{77}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哎，兄弟。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86的车窗降了一半，停住。过了两秒，又降下来一截。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{79}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86的车窗降了一半，停住。过了两秒，又降下来一截。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 开车的是个二十出头的黄毛，耳朵上三颗耳钉在路灯底下反着光。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{81}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[开车的是个二十出头的黄毛，耳朵上三颗耳钉在路灯底下反着光。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “开个破面包你嘚瑟什么玩意儿？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{83}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“开个破面包你嘚瑟什么玩意儿？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一不急，又慢慢嘬了一口烟。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{85}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一不急，又慢慢嘬了一口烟。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “我刚才在路口说什么，你听见了吧。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{87}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“我刚才在路口说什么，你听见了吧。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你他妈说什么关我屁……”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{89}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你他妈说什么关我屁……”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “下雪天，半热熔，都是傻X。”烟气从鼻腔里缓缓冒出来，“刚才那一甩，差点把车头送进对向车道。这一脚刹车，出线两米多。自己数数，今晚你还剩几个运气。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{91}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“下雪天，半热熔，都是傻X。”烟气从鼻腔里缓缓冒出来，“刚才那一甩，差点把车头送进对向车道。这一脚刹车，出线两米多。自己数数，今晚你还剩几个运气。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 黄毛的脸在霓虹底下红一阵白一阵。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{93}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[黄毛的脸在霓虹底下红一阵白一阵。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 他张了张嘴，低头瞅了一眼自己的方向盘。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{95}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[他张了张嘴，低头瞅了一眼自己的方向盘。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 雪还在往挡风玻璃上落。粉色的86趴在停止线外，引擎声收了，散热风扇还在嗡嗡转。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{97}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[雪还在往挡风玻璃上落。粉色的86趴在停止线外，引擎声收了，散热风扇还在嗡嗡转。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你懂个……”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{99}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你懂个……”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 绿灯亮了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{101}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯亮了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没等他把话说完，松刹车，给油，奥德赛汇进车流。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{103}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一没等他把话说完，松刹车，给油，奥德赛汇进车流。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 身后的86跟了上来，却乖乖缩在正后方，隔着三个车身，一路安安静静。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{105}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[身后的86跟了上来，却乖乖缩在正后方，隔着三个车身，一路安安静静。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智扭头看了半天，撇了撇嘴。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{107}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智扭头看了半天，撇了撇嘴。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “怂了？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{109}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“怂了？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “他那是想明白了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{111}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“他那是想明白了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一打了把方向，拐进通往老城区的岔路。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{113}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一打了把方向，拐进通往老城区的岔路。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “脑子这东西，有人充值早，有人充值晚。他今晚这几条胎，就当充值了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{115}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“脑子这东西，有人充值早，有人充值晚。他今晚这几条胎，就当充值了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智把瑰夏的杯盖按紧，嘬了一口，忽然嘿嘿笑出声。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{117}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智把瑰夏的杯盖按紧，嘬了一口，忽然嘿嘿笑出声。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，我发现你跟这台破奥德赛还挺配。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{119}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，我发现你跟这台破奥德赛还挺配。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{121}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“嗯？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “扮猪吃老虎啊。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{123}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“扮猪吃老虎啊。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “吃个屁。”侯天一瞥他一眼，“人家那车随便给一脚，够咱们追三条街。刚才那是他自己蠢。雪天，半热熔，弹离合，三个buff叠满，神仙来了也得甩尾。”
