paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{125}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“吃个屁。”侯天一瞥他一眼，“人家那车随便给一脚，够咱们追三条街。刚才那是他自己蠢。雪天，半热熔，弹离合，三个buff叠满，神仙来了也得甩尾。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那起步呢？”小智叼着吸管，“绿灯刚亮你就出去了，我咖啡都溅裤子上了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{127}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那起步呢？”小智叼着吸管，“绿灯刚亮你就出去了，我咖啡都溅裤子上了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “数灯。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{129}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“数灯。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{131}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“啥？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “倒计时读到1，对向的灯已经由红转黄。这时候松刹车，脚搭在油门上，本方向绿灯一亮，正好给油。快别人半秒。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{133}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“倒计时读到1，对向的灯已经由红转黄。这时候松刹车，脚搭在油门上，本方向绿灯一亮，正好给油。快别人半秒。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智听得一愣一愣的。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{135}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智听得一愣一愣的。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你哪学的？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{137}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你哪学的？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “开了八年车，路上喂出来的。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{139}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“开了八年车，路上喂出来的。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 前方的雪越下越密。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{141}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[前方的雪越下越密。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 拐过最后一个红绿灯，老城区的路灯换成了一串一串的红灯笼。巷子口那家羊汤馆还亮着，玻璃上蒙着一层暖黄的水汽。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{143}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[拐过最后一个红绿灯，老城区的路灯换成了一串一串的红灯笼。巷子口那家羊汤馆还亮着，玻璃上蒙着一层暖黄的水汽。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “先喝碗羊汤？”侯天一减速，“明天再回爸妈那边。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{145}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“先喝碗羊汤？”侯天一减速，“明天再回爸妈那边。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “喝！羊油辣椒给我来两勺！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{147}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“喝！羊油辣椒给我来两勺！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你上火。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{149}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你上火。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “过年了哥，上火就上火。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{151}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“过年了哥，上火就上火。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一乐了，把车稳稳停在路边。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{153}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一乐了，把车稳稳停在路边。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 熄火。中控屏上的虚拟碟片转完最后一圈，DejaVu唱到了尾奏。四个车轮之外，只剩落雪的声音。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{155}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[熄火。中控屏上的虚拟碟片转完最后一圈，DejaVu唱到了尾奏。四个车轮之外，只剩落雪的声音。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那台粉色的86，早不知道消失在了哪条街。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{157}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那台粉色的86，早不知道消失在了哪条街。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 羊汤馆的玻璃门一推开，一股混着辣椒油和白胡椒的热气糊了满脸。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{159}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[羊汤馆的玻璃门一推开，一股混着辣椒油和白胡椒的热气糊了满脸。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “老板！两碗羊汤！一碗多放羊油辣椒！”小智嗓门比谁都大。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{161}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“老板！两碗羊汤！一碗多放羊油辣椒！”小智嗓门比谁都大。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一在门口跺了跺鞋上的雪，回头看了一眼路边的白色奥德赛。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{163}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一在门口跺了跺鞋上的雪，回头看了一眼路边的白色奥德赛。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车顶已经积了薄薄一层白。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{165}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车顶已经积了薄薄一层白。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 明天，是除夕。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T21:12:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:47:13.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{167}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[明天，是除夕。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: Seed 2.1 pro
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:30.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:54:09.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{106}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[Seed 2.1 pro]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{109}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 绿灯亮了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{211}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯亮了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86的排气先炸了锅，嗡的一声闷响，车身猛地往前一蹿。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{214}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86的排气先炸了锅，嗡的一声闷响，车身猛地往前一蹿。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 然后横着滑了出去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{216}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[然后横着滑了出去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 半热熔胎在积雪的柏油面上根本咬不住地，后轮原地空转，白烟混着雪沫子往后甩，车头一歪，斜着溜向了旁边车道。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{218}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[半热熔胎在积雪的柏油面上根本咬不住地，后轮原地空转，白烟混着雪沫子往后甩，车头一歪，斜着溜向了旁边车道。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛反倒四平八稳地蹿了出去。轮胎压过路口的雪水，方向盘在侯天一手里轻轻抖了两下，被他随手按住。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{220}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛反倒四平八稳地蹿了出去。轮胎压过路口的雪水，方向盘在侯天一手里轻轻抖了两下，被他随手按住。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “卧槽！卧槽卧槽！”小智整个人从座椅上弹起来，安全带勒得锁骨生疼，“他飘了！哥你快看，他横着走了！哎哎，后边那车差点怼上他！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{222}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“卧槽！卧槽卧槽！”小智整个人从座椅上弹起来，安全带勒得锁骨生疼，“他飘了！哥你快看，他横着走了！哎哎，后边那车差点怼上他！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 身后喇叭声响成一片。86在路口中间扭了个小半圈，好歹被车主救了回来，发动机还在一声接一声地干吼。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{224}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[身后喇叭声响成一片。86在路口中间扭了个小半圈，好歹被车主救了回来，发动机还在一声接一声地干吼。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “说了，这个天套着半热熔跑大街的，都是傻X。”侯天一单手搭着方向盘，另一只手把烟屁股按进烟灰缸，语气平得像在报菜名。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{226}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“说了，这个天套着半热熔跑大街的，都是傻X。”侯天一单手搭着方向盘，另一只手把烟屁股按进烟灰缸，语气平得像在报菜名。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你……你早就料到了？”小智扒着后车窗往外看，粉色的86正在雪地里手忙脚乱地调头，“你刚才讲那一堆轮胎的事儿，是挖坑等他呢？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{228}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你……你早就料到了？”小智扒着后车窗往外看，粉色的86正在雪地里手忙脚乱地调头，“你刚才讲那一堆轮胎的事儿，是挖坑等他呢？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “我讲给你听的。”侯天一拿起冰美式嘬了一口，冰块撞得杯壁咔咔响，“知识点，记牢。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{230}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“我讲给你听的。”侯天一拿起冰美式嘬了一口，冰块撞得杯壁咔咔响，“知识点，记牢。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智张了张嘴，半个字没接上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{232}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智张了张嘴，半个字没接上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛汇入主路。雪还在下，雨刮器吱呀吱呀地刮，刮一下，留半道水痕。侯天一骂了句脏话，顺手把雨刮档位调高了一格。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{234}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛汇入主路。雪还在下，雨刮器吱呀吱呀地刮，刮一下，留半道水痕。侯天一骂了句脏话，顺手把雨刮档位调高了一格。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车里头文字D的原声还在轰，鼓点密得像砸铁皮。小智跟着节奏晃了两下腿，又想起正事来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{236}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车里头文字D的原声还在轰，鼓点密得像砸铁皮。小智跟着节奏晃了两下腿，又想起正事来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，老车的事儿。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{238}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，老车的事儿。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{240}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“嗯？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “就你们家那台闲着的老车，借我练练手呗，我保证不造。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{242}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“就你们家那台闲着的老车，借我练练手呗，我保证不造。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一盯着前车的尾灯看了几秒。红光落在湿路面上，拖出一道一道晃悠的影子。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{244}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一盯着前车的尾灯看了几秒。红光落在湿路面上，拖出一道一道晃悠的影子。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “车是有一台，在我爸车库搁快两年了。”他顿了顿，“能不能开，得先看过才知道。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{246}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“车是有一台，在我爸车库搁快两年了。”他顿了顿，“能不能开，得先看过才知道。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “啥车啊？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{248}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“啥车啊？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “见着你就知道了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{250}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“见着你就知道了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智还想刨根问底，兜里的手机震了起来。掏出来一瞅，屏幕上跳着个“妈”字。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{252}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智还想刨根问底，兜里的手机震了起来。掏出来一瞅，屏幕上跳着个“妈”字。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “喂，妈……啊对，回来了，跟天一哥在一块儿呢……吃了，早吃了……啥？咱家车打不着火了？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{C78890C3-0A86-44AC-88EF-30CEBF6BA370}{254}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“喂，妈……啊对，回来了，跟天一哥在一块儿呢……吃了，早吃了……啥？咱家车打不着火了？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 他的声音一下子拔高，侯天一斜了他一眼。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{10}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[他的声音一下子拔高，侯天一斜了他一眼。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “让我爸看一眼啊？……啊？我爸喝了多少？”小智捂着话筒，扭头冲侯天一挤眉弄眼，“哥，我妈说家里车趴窝了，我爸中午就喝上了，动不了。年夜饭还等我回去呢。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{12}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“让我爸看一眼啊？……啊？我爸喝了多少？”小智捂着话筒，扭头冲侯天一挤眉弄眼，“哥，我妈说家里车趴窝了，我爸中午就喝上了，动不了。年夜饭还等我回去呢。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你家老院子在城东吧？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{14}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你家老院子在城东吧？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “对对对，城东。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{16}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“对对对，城东。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一打着转向灯，奥德赛顺滑地并入左转车道，车身侧倾了一小下，又稳稳回正。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{18}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一打着转向灯，奥德赛顺滑地并入左转车道，车身侧倾了一小下，又稳稳回正。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “先去你家。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{20}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“先去你家。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那你呢，你不回去过年？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{22}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那你呢，你不回去过年？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “我一个人住，早一顿晚一顿都一样。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{24}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“我一个人住，早一顿晚一顿都一样。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车厢静了几秒，只剩音响里的鼓点和雨刮的响动。小智盯着侯天一的侧脸看了一会儿，忽然觉得这哥比刚才路口那台86还让人看不透。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{26}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车厢静了几秒，只剩音响里的鼓点和雨刮的响动。小智盯着侯天一的侧脸看了一会儿，忽然觉得这哥比刚才路口那台86还让人看不透。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 就在这时候，后视镜里亮起两束远光。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{28}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[就在这时候，后视镜里亮起两束远光。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 引擎声由远及近，改装排气特有的噼啪声混在风雪里，一下一下往耳朵里钻。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{30}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[引擎声由远及近，改装排气特有的噼啪声混在风雪里，一下一下往耳朵里钻。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 粉色的86追上来了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{32}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[粉色的86追上来了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “操，他还真追！”小智刚松开的安全带又被他一把扯紧，“哥，他闪灯呢，他冲咱们闪灯！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{34}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“操，他还真追！”小智刚松开的安全带又被他一把扯紧，“哥，他闪灯呢，他冲咱们闪灯！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86从右侧车道并排靠了上来，车窗摇下，驾驶位那张脸被雪光映得发青，嘴里不干不净地喊着什么，被风撕得只剩几个脏字。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{36}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86从右侧车道并排靠了上来，车窗摇下，驾驶位那张脸被雪光映得发青，嘴里不干不净地喊着什么，被风撕得只剩几个脏字。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 副驾的黑丝小姐姐也放下了手机，隔着两车之间的雪雾冲这边比手势。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{38}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[副驾的黑丝小姐姐也放下了手机，隔着两车之间的雪雾冲这边比手势。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，他骂你！”小智的脸涨得通红，半个身子都要压到方向盘上，“你倒是开窗啊！骂人这事儿我专业！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{40}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，他骂你！”小智的脸涨得通红，半个身子都要压到方向盘上，“你倒是开窗啊！骂人这事儿我专业！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没看右边，眼睛盯着前方。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{42}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一没看右边，眼睛盯着前方。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 前面路口的绿灯开始闪，三下，转成了黄。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{44}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[前面路口的绿灯开始闪，三下，转成了黄。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 他把冰美式塞进杯架，两只手重新搭上方向盘，右脚从油门上挪开，悬在刹车和油门之间。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{46}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[他把冰美式塞进杯架，两只手重新搭上方向盘，右脚从油门上挪开，悬在刹车和油门之间。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86的车主也看见了黄灯，排气声陡然拔高，车身往前蹿了半个头，摆明了要抢在红灯前冲过路口。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{48}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86的车主也看见了黄灯，排气声陡然拔高，车身往前蹿了半个头，摆明了要抢在红灯前冲过路口。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “他要闯灯！”小智喊。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{50}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“他要闯灯！”小智喊。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “他轮胎热了。”侯天一的声音压得很低，“这段路撒过融雪盐，路面是干的。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{52}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“他轮胎热了。”侯天一的声音压得很低，“这段路撒过融雪盐，路面是干的。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智一愣，再看那台86，后轮果然不再空甩，胎面咬住干地，车头一下一下往前拱。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{54}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智一愣，再看那台86，后轮果然不再空甩，胎面咬住干地，车头一下一下往前拱。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 黄灯最后一闪。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{56}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[黄灯最后一闪。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86嗡地一声蹿了出去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{58}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86嗡地一声蹿了出去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛没动。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{60}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛没动。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 红灯跳亮的瞬间，路口左侧的雪幕里猛地冲出两束灯光，一辆环卫除雪车按着喇叭横了过来，车前的推雪铲正好卡在86前一秒的位置。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{62}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[红灯跳亮的瞬间，路口左侧的雪幕里猛地冲出两束灯光，一辆环卫除雪车按着喇叭横了过来，车前的推雪铲正好卡在86前一秒的位置。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86的车主一脚刹车跺死，轮胎在干地上拉出两声尖啸，整车在停止线前哆嗦着停住，离推雪铲不到半米。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{64}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86的车主一脚刹车跺死，轮胎在干地上拉出两声尖啸，整车在停止线前哆嗦着停住，离推雪铲不到半米。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智的呼吸卡在嗓子眼里，半天没吐出来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{66}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智的呼吸卡在嗓子眼里，半天没吐出来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 除雪车司机探出头骂了两句，关上车窗，慢悠悠地开走了。雪还在下，路口重新安静下来，只剩86的发动机在怠速里一抖一抖地响。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{68}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[除雪车司机探出头骂了两句，关上车窗，慢悠悠地开走了。雪还在下，路口重新安静下来，只剩86的发动机在怠速里一抖一抖地响。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一这才转过头，看了隔壁一眼，摇下自己这边的车窗。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{70}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一这才转过头，看了隔壁一眼，摇下自己这边的车窗。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 冷风裹着雪片灌进来，小智打了个寒颤。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{72}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[冷风裹着雪片灌进来，小智打了个寒颤。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “兄弟。”侯天一冲着86扬了扬下巴，声音不大，刚好够对方听见，“过年了，慢点开。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{74}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“兄弟。”侯天一冲着86扬了扬下巴，声音不大，刚好够对方听见，“过年了，慢点开。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 说完他升上车窗。绿灯重新亮起，奥德赛稳稳起步，驶过路口，把那台粉色的86和满路口的尾气一起留在了身后。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{76}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[说完他升上车窗。绿灯重新亮起，奥德赛稳稳起步，驶过路口，把那台粉色的86和满路口的尾气一起留在了身后。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智瘫在座椅里，后背的汗被冷风一激，凉得贴肉。他扭头看了侯天一半天，憋出一句。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{78}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智瘫在座椅里，后背的汗被冷风一激，凉得贴肉。他扭头看了侯天一半天，憋出一句。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，你早就看见那除雪车了？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{80}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，你早就看见那除雪车了？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没答，伸手把音响音量拧小了一格。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{82}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一没答，伸手把音响音量拧小了一格。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “这条路这个点，环卫除雪的车准在。”他说，“我下班天天走。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:51:21.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:51:41.000Z" objectID="{AB48A103-50A2-4EB4-A4CD-8FE0A08DE9BB}{84}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“这条路这个点，环卫除雪的车准在。”他说，“我下班天天走。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智咽了口唾沫，把这话在心里翻来覆去嚼了几遍，总觉得方向盘后边坐着的这人，心里头还藏着别的东西。

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛在铁门前停稳，发动机声音落下去。侯天一拉上手刹，解开了安全带。

paragraphs.text: 小智捏着杯子下车，人往门缝凑，冷风灌进领口，他打了个哆嗦，眼睛盯住那枚圆灯。

paragraphs.text: 侯天一锁好车，走到他侧边，抬手把人拨回巷子中间。“灯罩上全是灰，牌子看不清。明天除夕，先回家吃饭。”

paragraphs.text: “吃完我去拿那台的钥匙，布可以掀，打火的事别想。”侯天一说完，把奥德赛的钥匙在指间转了一圈。

paragraphs.text: “行行行，我今晚就用眼睛看，手指头不碰车。”小智笑出了声，空杯子被他捏得咔咔响，裤腿上的咖啡渍已经发暗。

paragraphs.text: 侯天一转身往家里的灯光走，开口喊他。“跟上。我想喝口热的，咖啡这玩意儿今晚够了。”

paragraphs.text: 小智又盯着那块缺角的车标看了两秒，到底没问出口，小跑着跟上去。薄冰在脚下碎开，巷子里留下一串湿脚印。

paragraphs.text: 半热熔的胎面在积雪上疯狂地空转，白烟和雪沫子搅在一起从后轮拱里喷出来，86的车尾晃了一下，电子稳定系统介入，动力被强行切断了一瞬。

paragraphs.text: 就这一瞬，奥德赛已经蹿出去了半个车身。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{23}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[就这一瞬，奥德赛已经蹿出去了半个车身。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{25}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "卧槽！"小智整个人弹起来扒住了仪表台。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{27}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["卧槽！"小智整个人弹起来扒住了仪表台。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{29}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一眼睛盯着前方，嘴角往上提了提。油门继续给着，奥德赛的2.4自吸发动机嘶吼得像一头上了年纪的驴，声音难听，但是诚实。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{31}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一眼睛盯着前方，嘴角往上提了提。油门继续给着，奥德赛的2.4自吸发动机嘶吼得像一头上了年纪的驴，声音难听，但是诚实。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{33}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 四条普通的雪地胎老老实实地咬住了路面。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{35}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[四条普通的雪地胎老老实实地咬住了路面。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86追上来了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{39}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86追上来了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{41}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 后视镜里那两颗圆灯越来越亮，发动机的声浪隔着两层玻璃都能听见。半热熔的胎温终于上来了一些，抓地力开始恢复，86一脚油下去，车头猛地往前一扎。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{43}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[后视镜里那两颗圆灯越来越亮，发动机的声浪隔着两层玻璃都能听见。半热熔的胎温终于上来了一些，抓地力开始恢复，86一脚油下去，车头猛地往前一扎。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{45}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哥，他追上来了！"小智扭过头去看后窗。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{47}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哥，他追上来了！"小智扭过头去看后窗。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{49}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "坐好。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{51}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["坐好。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{53}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一声音不大，但小智听出来了，这两个字跟平时说话的语气完全不一样。他老老实实转回身子，安全带勒进了锁骨里。

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{57}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛的时速已经到了八十。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{59}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛的时速已经到了八十。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{61}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 对于一台家用MPV来说，这已经是它能给出的全部诚意了。发动机在嚎，变速箱在嚎，连中控台里那个没有固定好的打火机都在跟着一块儿嚎。
