paragraphs.text: 86从左侧超了过去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{67}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86从左侧超了过去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{69}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 擦身而过的瞬间，小智看清了副驾那个黑丝小姐姐的表情。笑得很开心，嘴巴一张一合，大概率又在骂人。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{71}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[擦身而过的瞬间，小智看清了副驾那个黑丝小姐姐的表情。笑得很开心，嘴巴一张一合，大概率又在骂人。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{73}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一松了油门。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{75}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一松了油门。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{77}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛的速度慢慢降了下来，发动机的转速落回怠速区间，车厢里重新安静了。只剩下音响里头文字D的配乐还在亢奋地唱着什么"哒哒哒哒"。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{79}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛的速度慢慢降了下来，发动机的转速落回怠速区间，车厢里重新安静了。只剩下音响里头文字D的配乐还在亢奋地唱着什么"哒哒哒哒"。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{81}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哥，你就这么算了？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{83}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哥，你就这么算了？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{85}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "算了。"侯天一打了一把方向盘，变回了右侧车道，还顺手打了转向灯。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{87}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["算了。"侯天一打了一把方向盘，变回了右侧车道，还顺手打了转向灯。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{89}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智张了张嘴，又把话咽了回去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{91}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智张了张嘴，又把话咽了回去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{93}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "刚才那一下够了。"侯天一腾出一只手把音响的音量拧小了两格。"零下三度，积雪路面，他那套半热熔的起步抓地力连我这台两吨多的面包车都不如。等他胎温上来了，我拿头去追？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{95}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["刚才那一下够了。"侯天一腾出一只手把音响的音量拧小了两格。"零下三度，积雪路面，他那套半热熔的起步抓地力连我这台两吨多的面包车都不如。等他胎温上来了，我拿头去追？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{97}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "那你刚才踩那一脚是图什么？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{99}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["那你刚才踩那一脚是图什么？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{101}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "图爽。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{103}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["图爽。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{105}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智愣了两秒，随后一巴掌拍在了自己的大腿上，笑得整个人缩进了座椅里。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{107}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智愣了两秒，随后一巴掌拍在了自己的大腿上，笑得整个人缩进了座椅里。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{109}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "你他妈的，我还以为你要跟人家干到底呢，我心脏都快跳出来了。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{111}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["你他妈的，我还以为你要跟人家干到底呢，我心脏都快跳出来了。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{113}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "干到底？干什么底。拿奥德赛跟86干到底，那我不成曹州城第一大冤种了。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{115}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["干到底？干什么底。拿奥德赛跟86干到底，那我不成曹州城第一大冤种了。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{117}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 前方的86已经变成了一个模糊的红色尾灯光斑，雪花落在挡风玻璃上化成水珠，被雨刮器吱吱呀呀地扫到两边。侯天一拧开了暖风，出风口吹出来的热气带着一股子塑料味。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{119}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[前方的86已经变成了一个模糊的红色尾灯光斑，雪花落在挡风玻璃上化成水珠，被雨刮器吱吱呀呀地扫到两边。侯天一拧开了暖风，出风口吹出来的热气带着一股子塑料味。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{121}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "他那台车底盘压得那么低，轮眉都切了，你猜他过减速带的时候心不心疼？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{123}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["他那台车底盘压得那么低，轮眉都切了，你猜他过减速带的时候心不心疼？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{125}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智擦了擦笑出来的眼泪。"心疼吧。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{127}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智擦了擦笑出来的眼泪。"心疼吧。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{129}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "路面上还有积雪和融雪剂，他那个前铲跟铲雪车似的。今天晚上回去底盘得锈一圈。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{131}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["路面上还有积雪和融雪剂，他那个前铲跟铲雪车似的。今天晚上回去底盘得锈一圈。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{133}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一说完自己也乐了，拍了一下方向盘。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{135}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一说完自己也乐了，拍了一下方向盘。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{137}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "改车就是这样，好看归好看，实用性全喂了狗。你以后要是买车，记住，第一台车千万别买后驱。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{139}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["改车就是这样，好看归好看，实用性全喂了狗。你以后要是买车，记住，第一台车千万别买后驱。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{141}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "为啥？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{143}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["为啥？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{145}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "因为你会把自己转进绿化带里。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{147}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["因为你会把自己转进绿化带里。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{149}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智又开始翻那包白将军，翻了半天摸出最后一根，叼在嘴上。打火机在侯天一那边，他伸手去够仪表台，被安全带勒得够不着。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{151}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智又开始翻那包白将军，翻了半天摸出最后一根，叼在嘴上。打火机在侯天一那边，他伸手去够仪表台，被安全带勒得够不着。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{153}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哥，打火机。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{155}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哥，打火机。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{157}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一单手把打火机抛了过去。小智接住，点着，吸了一口，把烟雾吐在了车窗玻璃上。白雾在玻璃内侧散开，又被暖风慢慢吹淡了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{159}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一单手把打火机抛了过去。小智接住，点着，吸了一口，把烟雾吐在了车窗玻璃上。白雾在玻璃内侧散开，又被暖风慢慢吹淡了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{161}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哥，你刚才说你家有个不用的老车来着。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{163}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哥，你刚才说你家有个不用的老车来着。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{165}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "我什么时候说的。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{167}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["我什么时候说的。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{169}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "你没说，是我说的，但你也没否认啊。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{171}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["你没说，是我说的，但你也没否认啊。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{173}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一瞥了他一眼。这小子绕了一大圈又绕回来了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{175}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一瞥了他一眼。这小子绕了一大圈又绕回来了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{177}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "那台车不能给你。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{179}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["那台车不能给你。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{181}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "为啥？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{183}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["为啥？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{185}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "那是我爸留下来的。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{187}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["那是我爸留下来的。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{189}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车厢里安静了一会儿。小智嘴里的烟烧了一小截灰，也没去弹。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{191}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车厢里安静了一会儿。小智嘴里的烟烧了一小截灰，也没去弹。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{193}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "是那个……白色的轿车？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{195}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["是那个……白色的轿车？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{197}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "嗯。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{199}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["嗯。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{201}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智不说话了。他知道那台车。小时候过年的时候见过，停在老宅子的院子里，车漆上落着一层灰，后视镜上挂着一串褪了色的佛珠。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{203}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智不说话了。他知道那台车。小时候过年的时候见过，停在老宅子的院子里，车漆上落着一层灰，后视镜上挂着一串褪了色的佛珠。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{205}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 雪下得比刚才大了一些。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{207}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[雪下得比刚才大了一些。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{209}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一打开了远光灯，前方的路面被照得雪白一片，两排行道树的枝丫上挂满了雪，压得低低的，快要碰到路过的货车顶棚。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{211}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一打开了远光灯，前方的路面被照得雪白一片，两排行道树的枝丫上挂满了雪，压得低低的，快要碰到路过的货车顶棚。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{213}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "那台车我一直没舍得卖。每年过年之前我都会去车库里点一次火，热一热机器，免得放坏了。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{215}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["那台车我一直没舍得卖。每年过年之前我都会去车库里点一次火，热一热机器，免得放坏了。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{217}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "能开吗？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{219}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["能开吗？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{221}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "能开。就是离合器硬得跟踩砖头似的，你那小细腿踩不动。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{223}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["能开。就是离合器硬得跟踩砖头似的，你那小细腿踩不动。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{225}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智低头看了一眼自己的腿。也没多细啊。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{227}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智低头看了一眼自己的腿。也没多细啊。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:47:37.000Z" objectID="{9CAB21DD-4F5C-448B-A309-D7B8C46BA2EA}{229}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 续写到此形成一个完整的段落收束。从红绿灯起步的短暂"对决"，过渡到兄弟俩关于车的闲聊，最后引出父亲留下的那台老车和老宅，为后续剧情埋下钩子。核心逻辑：半热熔轮胎在雪地起步劣势被兑现（技术合理），侯天一的性格（懂车、克制、重感情）和小智的性格（冲、嘴碎、但懂分寸）都得到了延续。

paragraphs.text: 绿灯刺破雪幕。

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛宽大的车头猛地一沉，前轮短暂空转，橡胶在湿冷的雪泥路面撕出嗤啦一声闷响，带起的泥水狠狠拍在底盘上。

paragraphs.text: 车身像被人在屁股后面猛踹一脚，直直弹了出去。不是跑车那种尖锐的嘶鸣，是沉闷的、带着整个车身重量的咆哮。

paragraphs.text: “我操！”小智整个人被死死按进宽厚的座椅背里，安全带勒进肩膀的肉里。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: “我操！”小智整个人被死死按进宽厚的座椅背里，安全带勒进肩膀的肉里。]]>

paragraphs.text: 他下意识抓住头顶的拉手，指关节因为瞬间的发力绷得发白。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: 他下意识抓住头顶的拉手，指关节因为瞬间的发力绷得发白。]]>

paragraphs.text: 旁边的粉红色86反应更快。引擎高亢的尖啸撕裂空气，车头像离弦的箭，几乎是贴着奥德赛右侧的车头抢先半个身位窜出。雪花在它低矮的车身周围被气流搅成漩涡。

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没看右边。他左手拇指死死压着方向盘内侧，指肚被硬塑料硌得生疼。视线钉子般楔进前方被车灯劈开的、飘着雪沫的、湿漉漉的柏油路。霓虹招牌的光在挡风玻璃上拉长、扭曲、流淌。

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛庞大的车身成了此刻唯一的武器。他几乎没给油，只是死死稳住方向，让这头两吨重的白色猛兽凭借起步那一下的蛮横惯性，斜斜地、不讲理地朝着86窜出的路线挤过去。

paragraphs.text: 86的司机显然没料到这辆笨重的奶爸车敢这么玩。后视镜里，那张模糊的脸猛地转向这边，隔着两层玻璃都能感受到那股惊愕。那辆粉色的、姿态嚣张的低趴86，像突然被扼住了喉咙。它刚刚取得的那点领先优势，瞬间被奥德赛笨重却精准的“关门”动作抹平，甚至反超。

paragraphs.text: “卧槽！哥你慢点！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:
<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T18:44:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:49.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{158}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Google Sans Text';font-size:18.0pt;
color:#201F1E" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“卧槽！哥你慢点！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 后视镜里，粉色86还在路口中央剧烈扭动。车主手忙脚乱地反打方向盘修正姿态，那阵刺耳的轮胎尖叫被奥德赛远远甩在了车尾后面。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:

color:#201F1E" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[后视镜里，粉色86还在路口中央剧烈扭动。车主手忙脚乱地反打方向盘修正姿态，那阵刺耳的轮胎尖叫被奥德赛远远甩在了车尾后面。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一单手搭在方向盘上方，掌心感受着路面传来的细碎震颤。变速箱平顺地拉高转速，机舱传来沉闷而连续的运转声。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:

color:#201F1E" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一单手搭在方向盘上方，掌心感受着路面传来的细碎震颤。变速箱平顺地拉高转速，机舱传来沉闷而连续的运转声。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 前方五百米，是一个接近九十度的右转路口。沥青路面泛着深黑色的湿光，边缘还堆着环卫车刚铲开的冰棱。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:
<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T18:44:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:49.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{164}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Google Sans Text';font-size:18.0pt;
color:#201F1E" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[前方五百米，是一个接近九十度的右转路口。沥青路面泛着深黑色的湿光，边缘还堆着环卫车刚铲开的冰棱。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 后方终于炸响了一阵狂暴的排气声。86好不容易稳住了车身，仗着大马力在直道上疯狂缩短距离，车尾扬起大片浑浊的水雾。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:

color:#201F1E" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[后方终于炸响了一阵狂暴的排气声。86好不容易稳住了车身，仗着大马力在直道上疯狂缩短距离，车尾扬起大片浑浊的水雾。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一在入弯前三十米松开油门，右脚轻点刹车。防抱死系统的脉冲微弱地顶着鞋底，车速稳稳降到安全区间。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:
<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T18:44:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:49.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{168}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Google Sans Text';font-size:18.0pt;
color:#201F1E" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一在入弯前三十米松开油门，右脚轻点刹车。防抱死系统的脉冲微弱地顶着鞋底，车速稳稳降到安全区间。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 方向盘顺畅地切入。奥德赛庞大的车身在湿滑的弯道上划出一道规整的弧线，四条普通的四季胎死死压在干燥的沥青行车线上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:
<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T18:44:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:49.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{170}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Google Sans Text';font-size:18.0pt;
color:#201F1E" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[方向盘顺畅地切入。奥德赛庞大的车身在湿滑的弯道上划出一道规整的弧线，四条普通的四季胎死死压在干燥的沥青行车线上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 粉色86带着尖锐的刹车声冲了过来。后驱车入弯速度太快，冰冷的半热熔胎在弯心压到了结冰的白线，整台车瞬间推头，横着朝外侧绿化带滑过去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:
<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T18:44:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:49.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{172}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Google Sans Text';font-size:18.0pt;
color:#201F1E" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[粉色86带着尖锐的刹车声冲了过来。后驱车入弯速度太快，冰冷的半热熔胎在弯心压到了结冰的白线，整台车瞬间推头，横着朝外侧绿化带滑过去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 伴随一声凄厉的擦碰声，86在距离马路牙子只有几公分的地方勉强停下，车轮陷进路边的泥雪里，当场熄了火。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:
<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T18:44:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:49.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{174}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Google Sans Text';font-size:18.0pt;
color:#201F1E" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[伴随一声凄厉的擦碰声，86在距离马路牙子只有几公分的地方勉强停下，车轮陷进路边的泥雪里，当场熄了火。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一顺手回正方向盘，奥德赛平稳驶入空旷的主干道。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:
<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T18:44:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:49.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{176}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Google Sans Text';font-size:18.0pt;
color:#201F1E" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一顺手回正方向盘，奥德赛平稳驶入空旷的主干道。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯广智这才长长吐出一口气，手心里全是黏腻的冷汗。他低头看了看怀里完好无损的咖啡，又转头看了看身旁单手开车的堂哥。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:
<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T18:44:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:49.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{178}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Google Sans Text';font-size:18.0pt;
color:#201F1E" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯广智这才长长吐出一口气，手心里全是黏腻的冷汗。他低头看了看怀里完好无损的咖啡，又转头看了看身旁单手开车的堂哥。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，你刚才……真他妈像拓海。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:
<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T18:44:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:49.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{180}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Google Sans Text';font-size:18.0pt;
color:#201F1E" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，你刚才……真他妈像拓海。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一伸手把暖风往上拨了一档，顺势夺过小智手里的冰美式，咬住吸管吸了一大口。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:

color:#201F1E" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一伸手把暖风往上拨了一档，顺势夺过小智手里的冰美式，咬住吸管吸了一大口。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “大冷天套半热熔跑街，神仙来了也得原地打转。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:
<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T18:44:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:49.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{184}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Google Sans Text';font-size:18.0pt;
color:#201F1E" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“大冷天套半热熔跑街，神仙来了也得原地打转。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 绿灯亮起。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T20:59:58.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:35:16.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{204}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯亮起。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T20:59:58.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:35:16.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{206}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一右脚掌压住油门，奥德赛车头轻轻一沉。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T20:59:58.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:35:16.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{208}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一右脚掌压住油门，奥德赛车头轻轻一沉。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T20:59:58.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:35:16.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{210}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 雪粒被卷进前轮拱，底盘传来细碎的敲击声。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T20:59:58.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:35:16.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{212}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[雪粒被卷进前轮拱，底盘传来细碎的敲击声。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T20:59:58.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:35:16.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{214}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>
