paragraphs.text: 绿灯瞬间亮起，侯天一猛地踩下油门，奥德赛如被唤醒般窜了出去。小智狠狠抓住扶手，车内瞬间充斥着轮胎与地面摩擦的尖锐声响。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{196}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯瞬间亮起，侯天一猛地踩下油门，奥德赛如被唤醒般窜了出去。小智狠狠抓住扶手，车内瞬间充斥着轮胎与地面摩擦的尖锐声响。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{198}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 丰田86也不甘示弱，紧随其后，试图超越。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{200}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[丰田86也不甘示弱，紧随其后，试图超越。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{202}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 然而，侯天一对这段路太熟悉了。几个快节奏的转弯，奥德赛在他手中如同一只灵活的捕鱼鲸，精准地在车流中穿梭。每一次转弯都稳若泰山。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{204}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[然而，侯天一对这段路太熟悉了。几个快节奏的转弯，奥德赛在他手中如同一只灵活的捕鱼鲸，精准地在车流中穿梭。每一次转弯都稳若泰山。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{206}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智的心却像坐在过山车上，一会儿悬空，一会儿急速下坠。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{208}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智的心却像坐在过山车上，一会儿悬空，一会儿急速下坠。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{210}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，你这是要干嘛？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{212}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，你这是要干嘛？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{214}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一嘴角挂着一抹不易察觉的笑，手中操控方向盘的力度丝毫不减。他似乎是在享受这种肾上腺素激增的感觉，而非简单的竞速。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{216}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一嘴角挂着一抹不易察觉的笑，手中操控方向盘的力度丝毫不减。他似乎是在享受这种肾上腺素激增的感觉，而非简单的竞速。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{218}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 转角处，86已经被远远抛开。小智从后视镜中看到那辆粉色的车渐渐远去，才略微松了口气。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{220}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[转角处，86已经被远远抛开。小智从后视镜中看到那辆粉色的车渐渐远去，才略微松了口气。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{222}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你这技术在哪练的，真有够飘逸的。”小智啧啧称奇。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{224}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你这技术在哪练的，真有够飘逸的。”小智啧啧称奇。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{226}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “嘿，平时多练练就好了。”侯天一淡淡道，似乎对刚才的表演毫不在意。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{228}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“嘿，平时多练练就好了。”侯天一淡淡道，似乎对刚才的表演毫不在意。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{230}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车子继续前进，城市的灯光反射在车窗上。今天的霓虹与平常不太一样，特别夺目。红色的、蓝色的光影不断交替，简直像是在为他们的这场小小冒险喝彩。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{232}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车子继续前进，城市的灯光反射在车窗上。今天的霓虹与平常不太一样，特别夺目。红色的、蓝色的光影不断交替，简直像是在为他们的这场小小冒险喝彩。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{234}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车内再次安静下来，只余下音乐轻缓的旋律与马达的低鸣。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{236}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车内再次安静下来，只余下音乐轻缓的旋律与马达的低鸣。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{238}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，那刚才的歌单……是你小时候最爱的那个，拓海的？”小智忽然想起刚才音乐的旋律，试探地问。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{240}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，那刚才的歌单……是你小时候最爱的那个，拓海的？”小智忽然想起刚才音乐的旋律，试探地问。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{C0E36906-8F7E-4E6E-9757-F7C9CB6C33EB}{242}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “嗯，那时候觉得开车是件特别酷的事情，看着拓海总能飙得那么厉害，心里也痒得不行。现在想想，那种感觉还真不错。”

paragraphs.text: “你倒是活成了小时候的样子。”小智忍不住感慨。

paragraphs.text: “有时候，我们追寻的，不就是那个小时候梦想过的样子么？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{10}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“有时候，我们追寻的，不就是那个小时候梦想过的样子么？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{12}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “天一，这个春节你准备怎么过？总不能一直跑车吧。”小智靠在椅背上，舒适地问。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{22}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“天一，这个春节你准备怎么过？总不能一直跑车吧。”小智靠在椅背上，舒适地问。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “家常便饭而已，也许会带你出去走走。”侯天一说罢，有意无意瞟了一眼路边飞速闪过的招牌。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{26}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“家常便饭而已，也许会带你出去走走。”侯天一说罢，有意无意瞟了一眼路边飞速闪过的招牌。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智看向窗外，满满的回忆袭来。他突然心生念头：“要不，我们找个地方吃点东西，再去看看之前的那座小学校？”

paragraphs.text: “味道还是没变。”侯天一的声音轻而满足。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{50}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“味道还是没变。”侯天一的声音轻而满足。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{52}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 交谈中，两人不时回忆起年轻时的囧事，谈论彼此这几年的成长和计划，时间悄然流逝。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{54}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[交谈中，两人不时回忆起年轻时的囧事，谈论彼此这几年的成长和计划，时间悄然流逝。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{56}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 饭后，他们慢步走在结了薄雪的小路上。街上的灯光把积雪映得亮晶晶的，偶尔一阵风吹过，带起几片落下的雪花。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{58}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[饭后，他们慢步走在结了薄雪的小路上。街上的灯光把积雪映得亮晶晶的，偶尔一阵风吹过，带起几片落下的雪花。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “前面就是小学了吧？”小智远远指着不远处的那栋老楼。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{62}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“前面就是小学了吧？”小智远远指着不远处的那栋老楼。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{64}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 虽已废弃多年，楼身早已褪去光彩，但在夜色中仍然能辨认出那熟悉的轮廓。那是记忆永恒的见证。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{66}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[虽已废弃多年，楼身早已褪去光彩，但在夜色中仍然能辨认出那熟悉的轮廓。那是记忆永恒的见证。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{68}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “进去看看吧。”侯天一不紧不慢地建议。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{70}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“进去看看吧。”侯天一不紧不慢地建议。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{72}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 他轻轻推开校门，那熟悉的吱呀声响起，仿佛在欢迎他们回家。两人并肩走着，小学的操场上空无一人，只有雪地上依旧留下他们儿时奔跑的影子。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{74}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[他轻轻推开校门，那熟悉的吱呀声响起，仿佛在欢迎他们回家。两人并肩走着，小学的操场上空无一人，只有雪地上依旧留下他们儿时奔跑的影子。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{76}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 站在操场中央，他们停下脚步，陷入短暂的沉默。仿佛一切都如当年般美好，无忧无虑。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{78}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[站在操场中央，他们停下脚步，陷入短暂的沉默。仿佛一切都如当年般美好，无忧无虑。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{80}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，你还记得这里的每个转角吗？”小智有些感慨。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{82}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，你还记得这里的每个转角吗？”小智有些感慨。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{84}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “当然记得，这里啊，承载了太多难忘的瞬间。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{86}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“当然记得，这里啊，承载了太多难忘的瞬间。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{88}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 此时，夜空中，雪花轻轻落下，覆盖在他们周围。灯光映照，仿佛一段梦回童年的光影。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{90}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[此时，夜空中，雪花轻轻落下，覆盖在他们周围。灯光映照，仿佛一段梦回童年的光影。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{92}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 聊了一会儿，他们不约而同地抬起头，对视一笑。尽在不言中。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{94}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[聊了一会儿，他们不约而同地抬起头，对视一笑。尽在不言中。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{96}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 终于，带着满满的回忆，两人再次返回车中，缓缓驶离了曾经嬉笑大闹的校园。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{98}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[终于，带着满满的回忆，两人再次返回车中，缓缓驶离了曾经嬉笑大闹的校园。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{100}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 夜已深，一切都变得格外静谧，奥德赛在空旷的街道上行驶，四周只有风的低语。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{102}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[夜已深，一切都变得格外静谧，奥德赛在空旷的街道上行驶，四周只有风的低语。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{104}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “回家吧。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{106}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“回家吧。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:36.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{108}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 是时候，回归温暖的家园了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T17:57:37.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{110}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[是时候，回归温暖的家园了。]]></one:T></one:OE>
