paragraphs.text: 小智整个人被按进了座椅里。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{145}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智整个人被按进了座椅里。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{147}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “卧槽？卧槽卧槽卧槽！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{149}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“卧槽？卧槽卧槽卧槽！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{151}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 旁边的86动静可比他俩大多了。发动机扯着嗓子干嚎，后轮在屁股底下疯狂打转，两股白烟卷着雪粒子喷出来，跟谁在路口点了挂鞭似的。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{153}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[旁边的86动静可比他俩大多了。发动机扯着嗓子干嚎，后轮在屁股底下疯狂打转，两股白烟卷着雪粒子喷出来，跟谁在路口点了挂鞭似的。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{155}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车是好车。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{157}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车是好车。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{159}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 走不走，看缘分。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{161}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[走不走，看缘分。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{163}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 零下几度的天，四条半热熔胎冻得邦邦硬，油门给得越狠，打滑打得越欢。粉色的车屁股左右甩了两下，硬是在原地画起了蛇形。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{165}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[零下几度的天，四条半热熔胎冻得邦邦硬，油门给得越狠，打滑打得越欢。粉色的车屁股左右甩了两下，硬是在原地画起了蛇形。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{167}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 等它找到抓地力，奥德赛已经晃晃悠悠过了大半个路口。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{169}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[等它找到抓地力，奥德赛已经晃晃悠悠过了大半个路口。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{171}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥！他追上来了！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{173}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥！他追上来了！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{175}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 后视镜里那团粉色越来越大。小智扒着椅背往后瞅，一只手死死攥着头顶的扶手，右脚还在地板上跟着使劲，恨不能替侯天一踩一脚刹车。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{177}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[后视镜里那团粉色越来越大。小智扒着椅背往后瞅，一只手死死攥着头顶的扶手，右脚还在地板上跟着使劲，恨不能替侯天一踩一脚刹车。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{179}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “坐稳你的。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{181}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“坐稳你的。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{183}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一瞟了眼前方的红绿灯，提前收油，脚不紧不慢地搭上了刹车。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{185}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一瞟了眼前方的红绿灯，提前收油，脚不紧不慢地搭上了刹车。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{187}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86的车主明显憋着一口气，车速起来了也不肯松，临到停止线才一脚跺死。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{189}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86的车主明显憋着一口气，车速起来了也不肯松，临到停止线才一脚跺死。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{191}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 这一脚下去，四条邦邦硬的轮胎彻底摆烂。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{193}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[这一脚下去，四条邦邦硬的轮胎彻底摆烂。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{195}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: ABS在脚下咔咔咔地弹，车头笔直地滑过停止线，一路滑进了路口正中间。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{197}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[ABS在脚下咔咔咔地弹，车头笔直地滑过停止线，一路滑进了路口正中间。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{199}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车身横过来的姿势还挺帅。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{201}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车身横过来的姿势还挺帅。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{203}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 方向拿反了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{205}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[方向拿反了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{207}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那台86在空旷的路口慢悠悠调了个头，最后脸冲着来路停稳。白烟混着雪雾，把它裹得严严实实。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{209}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那台86在空旷的路口慢悠悠调了个头，最后脸冲着来路停稳。白烟混着雪雾，把它裹得严严实实。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{211}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛安安稳稳停在停止线后头。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{213}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛安安稳稳停在停止线后头。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{215}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车厢里静了两秒。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{217}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车厢里静了两秒。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{219}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，他这算不算漂移啊？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{221}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，他这算不算漂移啊？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{223}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “算，原地漂移。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{225}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“算，原地漂移。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{227}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智盯着路口中间那台粉色的车看了半天，猛地反应过来，整个人在副驾上笑出了猪叫，一边笑一边拍大腿。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{229}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智盯着路口中间那台粉色的车看了半天，猛地反应过来，整个人在副驾上笑出了猪叫，一边笑一边拍大腿。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{231}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “黑丝！哥你快看那个黑丝！她在骂她对象！哈哈哈哈！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{233}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“黑丝！哥你快看那个黑丝！她在骂她对象！哈哈哈哈！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{235}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一也乐了，顺手又给自己续了根白将军。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{237}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一也乐了，顺手又给自己续了根白将军。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{239}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 绿灯亮起，奥德赛绕过横在路口的86，汇入了空荡荡的主路。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{241}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯亮起，奥德赛绕过横在路口的86，汇入了空荡荡的主路。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{243}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，你老实交代，以前是不是偷偷跑过山？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{245}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，你老实交代，以前是不是偷偷跑过山？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{247}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “跑个屁，我天天在家给你嫂子做饭。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{249}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“跑个屁，我天天在家给你嫂子做饭。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{251}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那你刚才那一手怎么解释？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{253}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那你刚才那一手怎么解释？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{17EF0C1A-E05B-4666-A26B-6025DB1E2177}{255}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “算牌，懂不懂。开车跟打麻将一个道理。他那四条胎搁这天儿里就是四个白板，谁碰谁点炮。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{11}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“算牌，懂不懂。开车跟打麻将一个道理。他那四条胎搁这天儿里就是四个白板，谁碰谁点炮。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{13}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智似懂非懂地点着头，忽然想起了正事。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{15}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智似懂非懂地点着头，忽然想起了正事。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{17}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哎哥，那咱家那台老车，借我练手的事儿……”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{19}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哎哥，那咱家那台老车，借我练手的事儿……”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{21}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “行啊。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{23}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“行啊。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{25}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{27}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“真的？！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{29}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “过完年再说。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{31}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“过完年再说。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{33}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “操，你这说了跟没说一样。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{35}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“操，你这说了跟没说一样。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{37}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一笑了笑没接话，腾出一只手把冰美式最后一口吸溜干净，空杯顺手塞回小智怀里。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{39}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一笑了笑没接话，腾出一只手把冰美式最后一口吸溜干净，空杯顺手塞回小智怀里。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{41}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “一百八，压岁钱里扣。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{43}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“一百八，压岁钱里扣。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{45}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 雪还在下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:36:40.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:33:33.000Z" objectID="{D389B85B-198A-4513-94A7-E19046688A86}{51}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[雪还在下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: Gpt-6-astra-pro
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-12T21:01:25.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{154}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[Gpt-6-astra-pro]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-12T21:01:23.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{158}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 绿灯亮起来的时候，小智已经把后背贴实了，连两条腿都绷在座椅下面，眼睛死死盯着前面的斑马线。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{162}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯亮起来的时候，小智已经把后背贴实了，连两条腿都绷在座椅下面，眼睛死死盯着前面的斑马线。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一松开刹车，奥德赛往前挪了一截，杯架里的冰块轻轻碰了两声，旁边却突然传来一阵尖锐的轮胎声。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{164}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一松开刹车，奥德赛往前挪了一截，杯架里的冰块轻轻碰了两声，旁边却突然传来一阵尖锐的轮胎声。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 粉色86的后轮卷起雪水，车尾朝右偏了一下，发动机还在吼，车头已经歪着朝旁边车道探了过去。

paragraphs.text: “卧槽，卧槽！”小智下意识抬起右手，掌心贴住车门，肩膀往侯天一这边缩，安全带一下勒紧了胸口。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{168}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“卧槽，卧槽！”小智下意识抬起右手，掌心贴住车门，肩膀往侯天一这边缩，安全带一下勒紧了胸口。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一收了些油门，等那辆86晃了两下重新摆正，才继续往前越过斑马线，顺手拨下了右转向灯。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{170}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一收了些油门，等那辆86晃了两下重新摆正，才继续往前越过斑马线，顺手拨下了右转向灯。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智瞪着仪表盘看了半天，又扭头看了一眼已经蹿出去的86，右手还贴在门上，嘴巴先张开了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{172}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智瞪着仪表盘看了半天，又扭头看了一眼已经蹿出去的86，右手还贴在门上，嘴巴先张开了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，你干啥呢？走啊！”他指着前面逐渐拉开的车距，刚才那点害怕已经顾不上了，“他都跑了！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{174}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，你干啥呢？走啊！”他指着前面逐渐拉开的车距，刚才那点害怕已经顾不上了，“他都跑了！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “他跑他的。”侯天一跟着导向线拐进右边的街口，把暖风往上调了一格，“咱们家在这边。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{176}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“他跑他的。”侯天一跟着导向线拐进右边的街口，把暖风往上调了一格，“咱们家在这边。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智扶着车门坐正，看看侯天一，再看看中控屏。音响里唱得正起劲，导航却突然插进来一句前方有减速带。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{178}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智扶着车门坐正，看看侯天一，再看看中控屏。音响里唱得正起劲，导航却突然插进来一句前方有减速带。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛压过减速带，前后轻轻晃了两下，小智嘴里憋着的那口气总算吐出来，脸也跟着垮了下去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{180}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛压过减速带，前后轻轻晃了两下，小智嘴里憋着的那口气总算吐出来，脸也跟着垮了下去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那你刚才轰油门干啥？还让我绑安全带，整得跟他妈要上秋名山似的，我都寻思着给我妈发个消息了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{182}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那你刚才轰油门干啥？还让我绑安全带，整得跟他妈要上秋名山似的，我都寻思着给我妈发个消息了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一偏头看了他一眼，嘴角往上提了提：“我也没让你给你妈发消息啊。你准备发啥，年过完再回来？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{184}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一偏头看了他一眼，嘴角往上提了提：“我也没让你给你妈发消息啊。你准备发啥，年过完再回来？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你少跟我扯这个！”小智伸手把音乐暂停了，“就你刚才那个架势，谁能寻思你是来右拐的？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{186}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你少跟我扯这个！”小智伸手把音乐暂停了，“就你刚才那个架势，谁能寻思你是来右拐的？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车厢里突然安静下来，雨刮器贴着玻璃又刮了一声。侯天一忍了一会儿，终于笑出了声，右手拍了拍方向盘。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{188}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车厢里突然安静下来，雨刮器贴着玻璃又刮了一声。侯天一忍了一会儿，终于笑出了声，右手拍了拍方向盘。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哎，行了行了，明天哥请你吃饭。”他说着又瞅了眼小智，“刚才他车屁股动那一下，你往我这边挤啥？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{190}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哎，行了行了，明天哥请你吃饭。”他说着又瞅了眼小智，“刚才他车屁股动那一下，你往我这边挤啥？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “我看看你安全带系好没有！”小智抓起杯架里的咖啡嘬了一口，冰水凉得牙根发酸，偏偏还得把这一口咽下去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{192}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“我看看你安全带系好没有！”小智抓起杯架里的咖啡嘬了一口，冰水凉得牙根发酸，偏偏还得把这一口咽下去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一笑得更厉害了。前面又遇上红灯，他稳稳把车停住，拿纸擦了擦杯架边上溅出来的咖啡。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{194}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一笑得更厉害了。前面又遇上红灯，他稳稳把车停住，拿纸擦了擦杯架边上溅出来的咖啡。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智往窗外看了半天，憋着的那股劲慢慢过去，手指在杯盖上抠了两下，又把身子转了回来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{196}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智往窗外看了半天，憋着的那股劲慢慢过去，手指在杯盖上抠了两下，又把身子转了回来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “说正经的，哥，你们家那个老车到底还能不能开？我就用两天，给你加满油，回来再给你洗干净。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{198}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“说正经的，哥，你们家那个老车到底还能不能开？我就用两天，给你加满油，回来再给你洗干净。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “驾照拿了多久了？”侯天一看着他摸出手机，倒也没再逗他，“你上回说倒车入库压线，那是啥时候？”
