paragraphs.text: “大二寒假！早过了！”小智把电子驾驶证调出来，举到他面前，“你看清楚，我现在也是正儿八经的司机。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{202}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“大二寒假！早过了！”小智把电子驾驶证调出来，举到他面前，“你看清楚，我现在也是正儿八经的司机。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一看完日期，把他的手机推回去：“正好，先去老院子。你大伯让我把蒸锅带回去，车就在那儿。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{204}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一看完日期，把他的手机推回去：“正好，先去老院子。你大伯让我把蒸锅带回去，车就在那儿。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智立刻把咖啡放下了，连刚才被耍的事都搁到了一边：“钥匙你带着没？咱们现在就去试试？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{206}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智立刻把咖啡放下了，连刚才被耍的事都搁到了一边：“钥匙你带着没？咱们现在就去试试？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “着啥急。”侯天一重新起步，沿着街边往前开，“明儿年三十，你爸还能让你开着车出去瞎转？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{208}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“着啥急。”侯天一重新起步，沿着街边往前开，“明儿年三十，你爸还能让你开着车出去瞎转？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “我就熟悉熟悉。”小智低着头划拉手机，屏幕亮了一下，他手指停住，过了几秒才接着往下划。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{210}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“我就熟悉熟悉。”小智低着头划拉手机，屏幕亮了一下，他手指停住，过了几秒才接着往下划。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一瞥了眼后视镜，又瞥了眼他：“熟悉车还得提前打字报备？你跟谁说话呢，教练啊？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{212}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一瞥了眼后视镜，又瞥了眼他：“熟悉车还得提前打字报备？你跟谁说话呢，教练啊？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “室友，问我到家没有。”小智把手机往裤兜里一塞，拿起咖啡递过来，“哥，你再喝两口，凉得我胃疼。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{214}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“室友，问我到家没有。”小智把手机往裤兜里一塞，拿起咖啡递过来，“哥，你再喝两口，凉得我胃疼。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你点的冰美式，赖谁。”侯天一嘴上这么说，手还是把他那边的出风口往下拨了拨，“搁着吧，别喝了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{216}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你点的冰美式，赖谁。”侯天一嘴上这么说，手还是把他那边的出风口往下拨了拨，“搁着吧，别喝了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 街上的店铺渐渐少了，路边卖春联的摊子还亮着灯，摊主正踮着脚，把挂在铁架顶上的福字一张张摘下来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{218}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[街上的店铺渐渐少了，路边卖春联的摊子还亮着灯，摊主正踮着脚，把挂在铁架顶上的福字一张张摘下来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛拐进一条窄路，车灯照到老院门口，两扇铁门底下各垫着半块砖，中间留着一道够人侧身过去的缝。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{220}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛拐进一条窄路，车灯照到老院门口，两扇铁门底下各垫着半块砖，中间留着一道够人侧身过去的缝。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智推门下车，冷风顺着敞开的衣领灌进去，脖子立刻缩了起来。他伸手把拉链拽到头，跑过去搬门底下的砖。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{222}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智推门下车，冷风顺着敞开的衣领灌进去，脖子立刻缩了起来。他伸手把拉链拽到头，跑过去搬门底下的砖。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 砖头冻在地上，抠了两下没动，他用鞋尖踢了一脚，碎冰崩到裤腿上，铁门才拖着地皮让开了一截。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{224}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[砖头冻在地上，抠了两下没动，他用鞋尖踢了一脚，碎冰崩到裤腿上，铁门才拖着地皮让开了一截。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “大伯！”小智探头朝院里喊了一声，回应他的只有屋檐底下晃动的塑料布，门房里的灯倒是亮着。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{226}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“大伯！”小智探头朝院里喊了一声，回应他的只有屋檐底下晃动的塑料布，门房里的灯倒是亮着。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你大伯去前头买东西了，刚给我发的消息。”侯天一把车开进院里，停到水泥地的一侧，熄火下车。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{228}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你大伯去前头买东西了，刚给我发的消息。”侯天一把车开进院里，停到水泥地的一侧，熄火下车。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 墙根底下停着一辆蒙了车衣的轿车，车头朝着院门，四个轮子露在外头，旁边靠着一把扫雪的铁锹。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{230}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[墙根底下停着一辆蒙了车衣的轿车，车头朝着院门，四个轮子露在外头，旁边靠着一把扫雪的铁锹。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智走过去拎起车衣的一角，往上一掀，车顶积的薄雪顺着褶子滑下来，正好灌进了他的鞋帮里。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{232}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智走过去拎起车衣的一角，往上一掀，车顶积的薄雪顺着褶子滑下来，正好灌进了他的鞋帮里。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “操！”他原地跺了两下脚，侯天一已经走到另一边，把车衣往车头拢，“让你慢点，鞋湿了吧？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{234}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“操！”他原地跺了两下脚，侯天一已经走到另一边，把车衣往车头拢，“让你慢点，鞋湿了吧？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 灰色的桑塔纳露了出来，车漆洗得挺干净，左后门底下那道旧划痕还在，车窗上贴着一张褪了色的卡通贴纸。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{236}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[灰色的桑塔纳露了出来，车漆洗得挺干净，左后门底下那道旧划痕还在，车窗上贴着一张褪了色的卡通贴纸。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智弯腰擦了擦车玻璃，忽然咧开了嘴：“这玩意儿还没掉呢？我记着是小时候吃泡泡糖送的。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{238}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智弯腰擦了擦车玻璃，忽然咧开了嘴：“这玩意儿还没掉呢？我记着是小时候吃泡泡糖送的。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你贴的，你忘了？”侯天一把车衣卷起来，塞到墙边的塑料筐里，“我爸刮下来三张，就这张黏得最结实。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{240}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你贴的，你忘了？”侯天一把车衣卷起来，塞到墙边的塑料筐里，“我爸刮下来三张，就这张黏得最结实。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智隔着玻璃端详了一会儿，抬手比了比贴纸的位置。他当年得踩在后座上，才能把这玩意儿按到窗户上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{242}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智隔着玻璃端详了一会儿，抬手比了比贴纸的位置。他当年得踩在后座上，才能把这玩意儿按到窗户上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一从兜里掏出钥匙，插进锁眼拧了一下，拉开驾驶位的门，车里散出一股皮革和旧烟味。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{244}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一从兜里掏出钥匙，插进锁眼拧了一下，拉开驾驶位的门，车里散出一股皮革和旧烟味。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 座椅上还铺着那套木珠坐垫，中间的线断过几根，用红绳重新穿了起来，手一按，珠子就往旁边滑。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{246}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[座椅上还铺着那套木珠坐垫，中间的线断过几根，用红绳重新穿了起来，手一按，珠子就往旁边滑。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智低头往里看，指着方向盘笑了：“我小时候坐你腿上开过这车，你记不记得？就在这个院里。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{248}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智低头往里看，指着方向盘笑了：“我小时候坐你腿上开过这车，你记不记得？就在这个院里。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “记得。你把喇叭按着不松，隔壁出来问咱家是不是卖车。”侯天一朝驾驶位偏了偏头，“现在腿够长了，自己上。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{250}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“记得。你把喇叭按着不松，隔壁出来问咱家是不是卖车。”侯天一朝驾驶位偏了偏头，“现在腿够长了，自己上。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智搓了搓手，弯腰钻进去，膝盖先顶到了方向盘下面，赶紧伸手去摸座椅底下的调节杆。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{252}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智搓了搓手，弯腰钻进去，膝盖先顶到了方向盘下面，赶紧伸手去摸座椅底下的调节杆。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 座椅往后一滑，木珠坐垫跟着卷起来一截。他折腾了半天才坐稳，又伸出左脚，把离合器从头踩了一遍。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{1468AC40-E7AA-4C5B-B050-7A239E330625}{254}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[座椅往后一滑，木珠坐垫跟着卷起来一截。他折腾了半天才坐稳，又伸出左脚，把离合器从头踩了一遍。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一绕到另一边坐下，先把安全带扣好，伸手按住了他准备拧钥匙的手：“空挡看看，手刹拉着没。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{10}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一绕到另一边坐下，先把安全带扣好，伸手按住了他准备拧钥匙的手：“空挡看看，手刹拉着没。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智晃了晃挡杆，检查完手刹才打火。起动机转了两声，发动机着起来，方向盘在他掌心里轻轻颤着。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{12}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智晃了晃挡杆，检查完手刹才打火。起动机转了两声，发动机着起来，方向盘在他掌心里轻轻颤着。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 他低头瞅瞅仪表，又伸手拧了拧收音机，里面传出一阵沙沙声，按过两个台，才听见有人正在报卖家具的电话。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{14}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[他低头瞅瞅仪表，又伸手拧了拧收音机，里面传出一阵沙沙声，按过两个台，才听见有人正在报卖家具的电话。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “这车还挺好着啊。”小智把收音机关小，摸了一下挡把上磨光的数字，“我还寻思都放坏了呢。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{16}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“这车还挺好着啊。”小智把收音机关小，摸了一下挡把上磨光的数字，“我还寻思都放坏了呢。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你大伯上个礼拜还开着去赶集。”侯天一把暖风打开，“他嫌那辆车后头铺的垫子新，买条鱼都不舍得往里放。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{18}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你大伯上个礼拜还开着去赶集。”侯天一把暖风打开，“他嫌那辆车后头铺的垫子新，买条鱼都不舍得往里放。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智笑着挂上一挡，放下手刹，左脚刚往上抬了一点，车头便猛地顿了一下，紧接着，发动机的声音停了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{20}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智笑着挂上一挡，放下手刹，左脚刚往上抬了一点，车头便猛地顿了一下，紧接着，发动机的声音停了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 收音机里卖家具的人还在喊优惠，小智盯着熄下去的转速表，右手搭在挡把上，过了好一会儿才动。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{22}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[收音机里卖家具的人还在喊优惠，小智盯着熄下去的转速表，右手搭在挡把上，过了好一会儿才动。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “这个离合器，跟驾校那个有点区别。”他把挡杆摘回空挡，清了清嗓子，“我再适应适应。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{24}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“这个离合器，跟驾校那个有点区别。”他把挡杆摘回空挡，清了清嗓子，“我再适应适应。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一扭头看着窗外，肩膀动了两下，等小智重新打着火，才转回来：“行，车放久了，也得适应适应你。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{26}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一扭头看着窗外，肩膀动了两下，等小智重新打着火，才转回来：“行，车放久了，也得适应适应你。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你别老看我。”小智把坐垫往屁股底下拽了拽，右脚虚搭着油门，“你一看，我就想起来那个教练。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{28}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你别老看我。”小智把坐垫往屁股底下拽了拽，右脚虚搭着油门，“你一看，我就想起来那个教练。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 这回他抬得慢，脚底已经有点发酸，车身终于朝前挪了一小截。他赶紧稳住左腿，连呼吸都跟着放轻了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{30}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[这回他抬得慢，脚底已经有点发酸，车身终于朝前挪了一小截。他赶紧稳住左腿，连呼吸都跟着放轻了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 桑塔纳沿着水泥地缓缓往前走，车轮压过薄雪，底下传来细碎的声响，侯天一抬手指了指前面的空地。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{32}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[桑塔纳沿着水泥地缓缓往前走，车轮压过薄雪，底下传来细碎的声响，侯天一抬手指了指前面的空地。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “到那边停一下，先把停车找找。”他看着弟弟绷紧的下巴，伸手把收音机关了，“咱们就在院里练。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{34}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“到那边停一下，先把停车找找。”他看着弟弟绷紧的下巴，伸手把收音机关了，“咱们就在院里练。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智照着把车停稳，这回发动机还好好响着。他摘了挡，拉好手刹，嘴角刚翘起来，兜里的手机就震了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{36}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智照着把车停稳，这回发动机还好好响着。他摘了挡，拉好手刹，嘴角刚翘起来，兜里的手机就震了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一接过他递来的手机，原本准备搁到仪表台上，屏幕却又亮了一下，一条消息正好弹在中间。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{38}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一接过他递来的手机，原本准备搁到仪表台上，屏幕却又亮了一下，一条消息正好弹在中间。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “明早九点十六到，你穿厚一点。”侯天一顺嘴念完，转过头看他，“你们室友还挺疼人啊。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{40}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“明早九点十六到，你穿厚一点。”侯天一顺嘴念完，转过头看他，“你们室友还挺疼人啊。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智伸手就抢，安全带把人勒回去半截，手机只摸到了边。他耳朵有点发热，干脆伸手把发动机熄了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{42}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智伸手就抢，安全带把人勒回去半截，手机只摸到了边。他耳朵有点发热，干脆伸手把发动机熄了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “给我，哥，你别瞎看。”小智总算把手机拿回来，屏幕朝下扣在腿上，眼睛却一直看着挡风玻璃。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{44}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“给我，哥，你别瞎看。”小智总算把手机拿回来，屏幕朝下扣在腿上，眼睛却一直看着挡风玻璃。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一把手收回来，靠着椅背等了一会儿。小智磨蹭了半天，才把嘴张开：“就一个同学，过来玩两天。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{46}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一把手收回来，靠着椅背等了一会儿。小智磨蹭了半天，才把嘴张开：“就一个同学，过来玩两天。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “年三十，来曹州，玩两天。”侯天一点了点头，偏头去看窗外，“咱这儿旅游业啥时候这么争气了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{48}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“年三十，来曹州，玩两天。”侯天一点了点头，偏头去看窗外，“咱这儿旅游业啥时候这么争气了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智低头笑了一下，拇指在手机壳边上来回蹭，刚才练车时那么多话，到这会儿倒是全省下了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{50}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智低头笑了一下，拇指在手机壳边上来回蹭，刚才练车时那么多话，到这会儿倒是全省下了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “她家里人今年在外地，回去也是自己待着。”他停了停，又补上一句，“我就说，来这边吃个饭呗。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{52}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“她家里人今年在外地，回去也是自己待着。”他停了停，又补上一句，“我就说，来这边吃个饭呗。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一看了眼这辆老车，伸手拨正副驾驶歪着的出风口：“所以你想开车去接，顺道把人带家里？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{54}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一看了眼这辆老车，伸手拨正副驾驶歪着的出风口：“所以你想开车去接，顺道把人带家里？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “我总不能让人家下了火车再等公交吧。”小智这回答得挺快，声音落下去，又小声补了一句，“还下雪。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{56}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“我总不能让人家下了火车再等公交吧。”小智这回答得挺快，声音落下去，又小声补了一句，“还下雪。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 院门口传来塑料袋摩擦的声音，一个戴着绒线帽的男人提着东西走进来，胳膊底下还夹着两根大葱。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{58}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[院门口传来塑料袋摩擦的声音，一个戴着绒线帽的男人提着东西走进来，胳膊底下还夹着两根大葱。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智一看见人，赶紧开门下车：“大伯！”他接过男人手里的袋子，往里瞅了眼，“怎么买这么多豆腐？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{60}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智一看见人，赶紧开门下车：“大伯！”他接过男人手里的袋子，往里瞅了眼，“怎么买这么多豆腐？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你大娘让买的，我哪知道她要做啥。”侯天一的父亲摘下手套，朝车里看了看，“刚才谁开的，顿那一下挺响啊。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{62}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你大娘让买的，我哪知道她要做啥。”侯天一的父亲摘下手套，朝车里看了看，“刚才谁开的，顿那一下挺响啊。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一跟着下来，把车门关上：“你侄子。学校里麻将打得挺好，离合器还得再练练，俩脚顾不过来。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{64}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一跟着下来，把车门关上：“你侄子。学校里麻将打得挺好，离合器还得再练练，俩脚顾不过来。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “多开开就好了。”大伯接过车钥匙，顺手放回侯天一手里，“蒸锅在门房，盖儿在上头压着，别落下。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{66}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“多开开就好了。”大伯接过车钥匙，顺手放回侯天一手里，“蒸锅在门房，盖儿在上头压着，别落下。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智把豆腐搁进奥德赛后备厢，趁大伯去门房拿东西，凑到侯天一跟前，把声音压得很低。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{68}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智把豆腐搁进奥德赛后备厢，趁大伯去门房拿东西，凑到侯天一跟前，把声音压得很低。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，明早你跟我一块儿去呗。”他掏出手机看了眼时间，“我起步再练练，你坐边上，帮我瞅着点。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{70}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，明早你跟我一块儿去呗。”他掏出手机看了眼时间，“我起步再练练，你坐边上，帮我瞅着点。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一抬头看了眼还在飘雪的天。小智抿了抿嘴，伸手抓住他的袖口：“真挺重要的，你得陪我。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{72}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一抬头看了眼还在飘雪的天。小智抿了抿嘴，伸手抓住他的袖口：“真挺重要的，你得陪我。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “几点出门？”侯天一把桑塔纳锁好，手里的钥匙碰出两声轻响，小智肩膀一松，赶紧说早上八点。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{74}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“几点出门？”侯天一把桑塔纳锁好，手里的钥匙碰出两声轻响，小智肩膀一松，赶紧说早上八点。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “明天看路况，雪大了我开。”侯天一把钥匙揣进兜里，走向奥德赛，“坐这辆去，行李往后头一放就行。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{76}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“明天看路况，雪大了我开。”侯天一把钥匙揣进兜里，走向奥德赛，“坐这辆去，行李往后头一放就行。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智跟上来，绕着奥德赛看了两眼，伸手摸了摸侧滑门的把手：“其实吧，我刚才看这车，就觉得它挺大气的。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{78}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智跟上来，绕着奥德赛看了两眼，伸手摸了摸侧滑门的把手：“其实吧，我刚才看这车，就觉得它挺大气的。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一停下脚步，转头看着他。小智摸门把手的动作慢慢停了，咧开嘴笑：“坐着也舒服，真的。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{80}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一停下脚步，转头看着他。小智摸门把手的动作慢慢停了，咧开嘴笑：“坐着也舒服，真的。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “家庭煮夫那句你再说一遍。”侯天一抬手拉开后备厢，接过父亲搬来的蒸锅，“刚才在地库说得挺顺嘴啊。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{82}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“家庭煮夫那句你再说一遍。”侯天一抬手拉开后备厢，接过父亲搬来的蒸锅，“刚才在地库说得挺顺嘴啊。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智赶紧伸手托住锅底，帮着往里放，锅沿蹭到羽绒服上，留下一道灰印，他也顾不上拍。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{84}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智赶紧伸手托住锅底，帮着往里放，锅沿蹭到羽绒服上，留下一道灰印，他也顾不上拍。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “我给我嫂子拜年的时候，当面再夸一回，行了吧。”他把锅往里推稳，又伸手拽了拽，“明早肯定不能装这玩意儿。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{86}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“我给我嫂子拜年的时候，当面再夸一回，行了吧。”他把锅往里推稳，又伸手拽了拽，“明早肯定不能装这玩意儿。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “明早装这个干啥，赶集卖粥去啊。”侯天一把锅盖按好，转头正准备说话，父亲已经从门房拿出了一个小铝盆。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{88}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“明早装这个干啥，赶集卖粥去啊。”侯天一把锅盖按好，转头正准备说话，父亲已经从门房拿出了一个小铝盆。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智拎着铝盆往车上走，手机忽然响了。他看清屏幕上的名字，朝侯天一挤了挤眼睛，转身快步走到院门边。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{90}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智拎着铝盆往车上走，手机忽然响了。他看清屏幕上的名字，朝侯天一挤了挤眼睛，转身快步走到院门边。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一站在车尾，刚把后备厢关好，就听见小智那边接起电话，声音比刚才低了一截，连说了两声到了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{92}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一站在车尾，刚把后备厢关好，就听见小智那边接起电话，声音比刚才低了一截，连说了两声到了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 风从院门口吹进来，小智拉着衣领挡住嘴，电话那头说了什么，他脚下突然停住，抬头看向院里。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{94}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[风从院门口吹进来，小智拉着衣领挡住嘴，电话那头说了什么，他脚下突然停住，抬头看向院里。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “啥？”小智把手机往耳朵上贴紧，声音一下提了起来，“我妈加你微信了？啥时候加的？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{96}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“啥？”小智把手机往耳朵上贴紧，声音一下提了起来，“我妈加你微信了？啥时候加的？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一偏过头，看见父亲正在拍裤腿上的灰。老头抬眼瞅了瞅门口，又从兜里摸出一副手套戴上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{98}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一偏过头，看见父亲正在拍裤腿上的灰。老头抬眼瞅了瞅门口，又从兜里摸出一副手套戴上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你妈让带六个盆，我多拿了一个。”父亲朝后备厢扬了扬下巴，“明天人多，盛饺子用得上。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-11T09:45:11.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:34:33.000Z" objectID="{F140526A-0EDB-4EA8-B64A-1F6223971B9D}{100}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:18.0pt" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你妈让带六个盆，我多拿了一个。”父亲朝后备厢扬了扬下巴，“明天人多，盛饺子用得上。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智还举着手机站在风里，侯天一已经拉开驾驶位的门，隔着半个院子，笑着冲他招了招手。

paragraphs.text: “侯师傅，先上车吧。”他点亮中控屏，把刚才那首歌重新放出来，“你负责跟你妈解释，我负责开车。”

paragraphs.text: 侯天一松开刹车踩上油门。奥德赛两吨出头的车身在薄雪上打了半圈空转，四条轮胎随即咬住地面，整台车冲了出去。

paragraphs.text: 旁边传来一声尖锐的胎叫。

paragraphs.text: 86的后轮在雪面上疯狂地空转了将近两秒，白色的雪沫从轮拱里喷射出来，车尾甩出了一个小幅度的摆动。半热熔的宽胎在这个温度下根本热不起来，全宽的胎面找不到一丁点排水槽去啃住路面。

paragraphs.text: 侯天一的奥德赛已经领先了半个车身。

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{157}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 这个优势只维持了不到三秒。86的后轮终于找到了一点摩擦力，排气管炸出一连串的回火声，粉色的车身嗖地窜到了前面。

paragraphs.text: 一个车身，两个车身，三个车身。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{163}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[一个车身，两个车身，三个车身。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{165}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一收了油门。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{167}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一收了油门。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "啧。"

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{173}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 速度表的指针从七十慢慢回落到六十。他的右手重新搭回方向盘的顶端，食指跟着BGM的节拍一下一下敲着。

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{177}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哥！追啊！他车屁股都快看不见了！"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{179}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哥！追啊！他车屁股都快看不见了！"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{181}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "追什么，又不是秋名山。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{183}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["追什么，又不是秋名山。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{185}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智瞪大了眼睛看着侯天一，又转头去看前方那对越来越小的红色尾灯，满脸写着不甘心。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{187}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智瞪大了眼睛看着侯天一，又转头去看前方那对越来越小的红色尾灯，满脸写着不甘心。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{189}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "那你刚才轰油门干嘛！起步还冲那么猛！"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{191}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["那你刚才轰油门干嘛！起步还冲那么猛！"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{193}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "让他知道一下，半热熔在雪天起步连一台奥德赛都跑不过。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{195}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["让他知道一下，半热熔在雪天起步连一台奥德赛都跑不过。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{197}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智张了张嘴，半天说不出话来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{199}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智张了张嘴，半天说不出话来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{201}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 两百米开外，86的刹车灯亮了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{203}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[两百米开外，86的刹车灯亮了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{205}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 又一个红绿灯路口。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{207}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[又一个红绿灯路口。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{209}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一匀速滑过去，奥德赛稳稳当当地停在了86的左后方。中控屏里的欧阳菲菲正唱到副歌，他随手把音量从十五推到了二十二。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{211}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一匀速滑过去，奥德赛稳稳当当地停在了86的左后方。中控屏里的欧阳菲菲正唱到副歌，他随手把音量从十五推到了二十二。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{213}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86的驾驶席车窗摇下来一半。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{215}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86的驾驶席车窗摇下来一半。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{217}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小伙子偏过头来，表情已经从愤怒变成了某种说不清道不明的东西。他盯着侯天一看了两秒，又看了看奥德赛车头上沾着雪的本田标，嘴唇动了动，到底什么也没说。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{219}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小伙子偏过头来，表情已经从愤怒变成了某种说不清道不明的东西。他盯着侯天一看了两秒，又看了看奥德赛车头上沾着雪的本田标，嘴唇动了动，到底什么也没说。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{221}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 副驾驶的黑丝小姐姐倒是探过身来瞅了一眼这边，视线正好和小智撞上了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{223}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[副驾驶的黑丝小姐姐倒是探过身来瞅了一眼这边，视线正好和小智撞上了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{225}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智赶紧把鸭舌帽帽檐往下压了压。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{227}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智赶紧把鸭舌帽帽檐往下压了压。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{229}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 绿灯。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{231}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{233}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86安安静静地驶入了右转车道，排气声浪温柔了许多。临走之前副驾驶的车窗又降下来一条缝，刚才竖着的中指变成了一个V字。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{235}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86安安静静地驶入了右转车道，排气声浪温柔了许多。临走之前副驾驶的车窗又降下来一条缝，刚才竖着的中指变成了一个V字。]]></one:T></one:OE>
