<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{237}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一瞄见了，嘴角动了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{239}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一瞄见了，嘴角动了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{241}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "嘿，他妈的。"小智拍了一下大腿，"和解了？这就和解了？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{243}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["嘿，他妈的。"小智拍了一下大腿，"和解了？这就和解了？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{245}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "人家也是懂车的人，起步那一脚心里就全明白了。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{247}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["人家也是懂车的人，起步那一脚心里就全明白了。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{249}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "明白什么？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{251}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["明白什么？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{253}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "明白这种天气穿着半热熔出来有多蠢。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{FDB62F8C-F2D9-4BD3-BFB2-DAC6A8119E8C}{255}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["明白这种天气穿着半热熔出来有多蠢。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{11}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一顺手把小智手中的冰美式拿过来仰头灌完了最后一口，冰块磕在牙齿上咯咯响。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{13}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一顺手把小智手中的冰美式拿过来仰头灌完了最后一口，冰块磕在牙齿上咯咯响。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{15}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智看着空了的杯子心疼了一秒。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{17}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智看着空了的杯子心疼了一秒。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{19}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "好家伙，这杯瑰夏我是一口福都没享到。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{21}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["好家伙，这杯瑰夏我是一口福都没享到。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{23}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "刚才那一大口不算？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{25}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["刚才那一大口不算？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{27}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "那个是惊吓，跟享福沾不上边。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{29}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["那个是惊吓，跟享福沾不上边。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{31}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛沿着主干道继续往北，穿过了城中心那段最亮的商业街。两侧的店铺正在陆续拉卷帘门，几家烧烤摊的炭火还红着，羊肉串的烟气顺着车窗缝钻进来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{33}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛沿着主干道继续往北，穿过了城中心那段最亮的商业街。两侧的店铺正在陆续拉卷帘门，几家烧烤摊的炭火还红着，羊肉串的烟气顺着车窗缝钻进来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{35}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智的肚子叫了一声。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{37}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智的肚子叫了一声。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{39}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哥，饿了。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{41}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哥，饿了。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{43}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "忍着，回家吃。你嫂子炖了骨头汤，火锅。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{45}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["忍着，回家吃。你嫂子炖了骨头汤，火锅。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{47}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "嫂子？"小智手里的吸管差点戳到眼睛。"你啥时候结的婚？你们家这么大的事不跟我说一声？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{49}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["嫂子？"小智手里的吸管差点戳到眼睛。"你啥时候结的婚？你们家这么大的事不跟我说一声？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{51}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "谁说结婚了。叫习惯了。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{53}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["谁说结婚了。叫习惯了。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{55}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一面无表情，眼睛只看路。小智盯着他的侧脸瞅了好几秒，啥信息也读不出来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{57}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一面无表情，眼睛只看路。小智盯着他的侧脸瞅了好几秒，啥信息也读不出来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{59}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哥，那个车的事你还没回我呢。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{61}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哥，那个车的事你还没回我呢。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{63}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "什么车。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{65}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["什么车。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{67}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "就家里那台老车啊，我不是说借来练练手嘛。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{69}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["就家里那台老车啊，我不是说借来练练手嘛。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{71}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一的拇指在方向盘的缝线上蹭了蹭。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{73}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一的拇指在方向盘的缝线上蹭了蹭。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{75}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "卖了。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{77}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["卖了。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{79}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "啊？卖了多少？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{81}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["啊？卖了多少？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{83}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "三万八。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{85}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["三万八。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{87}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "就三万八？那车当年不是十好几万买的吗。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{89}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["就三万八？那车当年不是十好几万买的吗。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{91}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "十年的车了，能值几个钱。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{93}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["十年的车了，能值几个钱。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{95}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车厢里安静下来。中控屏上的歌切到了下一首，合成器的前奏铺满了整个空间。小智低头搅着空杯子里剩下的碎冰，冰块碰着杯壁的声音在音乐的间隙里格外清脆。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{97}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车厢里安静下来。中控屏上的歌切到了下一首，合成器的前奏铺满了整个空间。小智低头搅着空杯子里剩下的碎冰，冰块碰着杯壁的声音在音乐的间隙里格外清脆。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{99}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 他想说点什么安慰的话，但看了一眼侯天一攥着方向盘的手背，还是闭上了嘴。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{101}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[他想说点什么安慰的话，但看了一眼侯天一攥着方向盘的手背，还是闭上了嘴。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{103}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 有些事情，回来了再慢慢问。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{105}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[有些事情，回来了再慢慢问。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{107}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛拐进老城区的巷子，两边平房门框上的春联都是今天刚贴的，红纸上的金粉还亮得很。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{109}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛拐进老城区的巷子，两边平房门框上的春联都是今天刚贴的，红纸上的金粉还亮得很。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{111}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车停了。引擎熄了。挡风玻璃上的雪片失去了雨刮器的阻挡，开始一片一片地往上叠。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{113}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车停了。引擎熄了。挡风玻璃上的雪片失去了雨刮器的阻挡，开始一片一片地往上叠。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{115}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智推开车门，一口冷气直接灌进了肺里，整个人缩着脖子跑到车尾等着侯天一开后备箱。嘴里呼出来的白气在路灯底下散成一团。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{117}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智推开车门，一口冷气直接灌进了肺里，整个人缩着脖子跑到车尾等着侯天一开后备箱。嘴里呼出来的白气在路灯底下散成一团。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{119}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一从后备箱里拎出两个塑料袋。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{121}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一从后备箱里拎出两个塑料袋。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{123}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "火锅底料，你嫂子让带的。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{125}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["火锅底料，你嫂子让带的。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{127}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "又嫂子。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{129}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["又嫂子。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{131}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一抬脚踹了他屁股一下。"走。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{133}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一抬脚踹了他屁股一下。"走。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{135}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 院门一推开，骨汤的香味和屋里的暖气一股脑涌出来。客厅中间支着折叠桌，电磁炉上的锅盖被蒸汽顶得一跳一跳，备好的菜码摆了满满一桌。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{137}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[院门一推开，骨汤的香味和屋里的暖气一股脑涌出来。客厅中间支着折叠桌，电磁炉上的锅盖被蒸汽顶得一跳一跳，备好的菜码摆了满满一桌。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{139}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 毛肚，鸭肠，嫩牛肉，冻豆腐，还有一盘切得极薄的羊肉卷。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{141}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[毛肚，鸭肠，嫩牛肉，冻豆腐，还有一盘切得极薄的羊肉卷。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{143}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 一个扎着马尾的女生从厨房探出头来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{145}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[一个扎着马尾的女生从厨房探出头来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{147}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "回来啦，这位是？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{149}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["回来啦，这位是？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{151}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "我弟，小智，深圳回来的。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{153}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["我弟，小智，深圳回来的。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{155}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "快进来快进来，外面冷。鞋换了啊，拖鞋在门口柜子里。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{157}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["快进来快进来，外面冷。鞋换了啊，拖鞋在门口柜子里。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{159}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智规规矩矩蹲下去换拖鞋的时候，余光扫到了客厅墙上贴着的一张海报。白色的AE86从弯道内侧切出来，车身倾斜的角度几乎贴着路面，尾灯拉成了一条长线。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{161}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智规规矩矩蹲下去换拖鞋的时候，余光扫到了客厅墙上贴着的一张海报。白色的AE86从弯道内侧切出来，车身倾斜的角度几乎贴着路面，尾灯拉成了一条长线。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{163}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 海报下面还有一张手绘的赛道图，红色箭头歪歪扭扭地标注着每一个弯心。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{165}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[海报下面还有一张手绘的赛道图，红色箭头歪歪扭扭地标注着每一个弯心。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{167}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 这确实是他哥会干出来的事。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{169}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[这确实是他哥会干出来的事。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{171}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "嫂子好。"小智站直了身子，喊得脆生。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{173}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["嫂子好。"小智站直了身子，喊得脆生。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{175}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 马尾女生笑着摆了摆手。"还嫂子呢，你哥就会瞎说。赶紧坐，马上开锅了。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{177}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[马尾女生笑着摆了摆手。"还嫂子呢，你哥就会瞎说。赶紧坐，马上开锅了。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{179}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一把底料倒进翻滚的骨汤里，红油瞬间在汤面上炸开了一层。他在桌边坐下来，给自己开了一罐冰啤酒。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{181}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一把底料倒进翻滚的骨汤里，红油瞬间在汤面上炸开了一层。他在桌边坐下来，给自己开了一罐冰啤酒。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{183}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 窗外的雪越下越密。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{185}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[窗外的雪越下越密。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{187}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 手机屏幕亮了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{189}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[手机屏幕亮了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{191}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车友群。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{193}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车友群。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{195}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "曹州赛道第三届春节友谊赛，大年初三，名额有限，报名从速。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{197}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["曹州赛道第三届春节友谊赛，大年初三，名额有限，报名从速。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{199}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一盯着这行字看了三秒。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{201}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一盯着这行字看了三秒。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{203}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哥，干一个。"小智举着从冰箱里翻出来的啤酒凑了过来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{205}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哥，干一个。"小智举着从冰箱里翻出来的啤酒凑了过来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{207}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一把手机翻过去扣在了桌面上，拿起啤酒罐。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{209}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一把手机翻过去扣在了桌面上，拿起啤酒罐。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{211}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "来。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{213}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["来。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{215}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 两个铝罐碰在一起。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{217}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[两个铝罐碰在一起。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{219}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 闷响。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:02:34.000Z" objectID="{94BC6AC8-5CC7-4380-B544-34B1E9044F08}{221}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[闷响。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: Fable
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:08:02.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:08:05.000Z" objectID="{23D0DBFD-977F-4876-8C4A-6C4FE2F611B1}{254}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[Fable]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “绿了！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" objectID="{23D0DBFD-977F-4876-8C4A-6C4FE2F611B1}{12}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“绿了！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" objectID="{23D0DBFD-977F-4876-8C4A-6C4FE2F611B1}{14}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智的喊声还没落地，侯天一的右脚已经沉了下去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" objectID="{23D0DBFD-977F-4876-8C4A-6C4FE2F611B1}{16}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智的喊声还没落地，侯天一的右脚已经沉了下去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" objectID="{23D0DBFD-977F-4876-8C4A-6C4FE2F611B1}{18}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛的电机先一步接管了车身，前轮咬着湿漉漉的柏油，悄没声地滑过了停止线，连一丝顿挫都摸不着。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" objectID="{23D0DBFD-977F-4876-8C4A-6C4FE2F611B1}{20}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛的电机先一步接管了车身，前轮咬着湿漉漉的柏油，悄没声地滑过了停止线，连一丝顿挫都摸不着。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" objectID="{23D0DBFD-977F-4876-8C4A-6C4FE2F611B1}{22}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 旁边的动静就大了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" objectID="{23D0DBFD-977F-4876-8C4A-6C4FE2F611B1}{24}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[旁边的动静就大了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" objectID="{23D0DBFD-977F-4876-8C4A-6C4FE2F611B1}{26}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86的排气炸了锅，两条后轮在雪水里疯狂空转，雪浆混着泥点子糊了半边后杠。车尾左扭一下，右扭一下，车头愣是钉在原地。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:55.000Z" objectID="{23D0DBFD-977F-4876-8C4A-6C4FE2F611B1}{28}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86的排气炸了锅，两条后轮在雪水里疯狂空转，雪浆混着泥点子糊了半边后杠。车尾左扭一下，右扭一下，车头愣是钉在原地。]]></one:T></one:OE>
