color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一的右脚往下压了小半截，奥德赛的车头轻轻一抬，四条普普通通的四季胎在薄雪上碾出一层细碎的沙沙声，稳稳地滑了出去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{101}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一的右脚往下压了小半截，奥德赛的车头轻轻一抬，四条普普通通的四季胎在薄雪上碾出一层细碎的沙沙声，稳稳地滑了出去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 旁边就热闹多了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{104}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[旁边就热闹多了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{106}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“呜……嗡！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 粉色86的尾巴猛地一沉，两条后轮在雪水里空转了两圈，排气管喷出一大团白气，车身却在原地扭了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{108}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[粉色86的尾巴猛地一沉，两条后轮在雪水里空转了两圈，排气管喷出一大团白气，车身却在原地扭了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智扭着脖子往右后方看，嘴里叼着的半截白将军差点掉进裤裆里。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{110}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智扭着脖子往右后方看，嘴里叼着的半截白将军差点掉进裤裆里。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，他没走啊！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{112}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，他没走啊！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “他走不了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{114}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“他走不了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一盯着前面，头都懒得回。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{116}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一盯着前面，头都懒得回。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 后视镜里，86的车尾划出一道不大不小的弧线，右后轮啃上了路中间隔离带的边石。车身歪着停了半秒，尾灯闪了两下，又开始往前蹿。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{118}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[后视镜里，86的车尾划出一道不大不小的弧线，右后轮啃上了路中间隔离带的边石。车身歪着停了半秒，尾灯闪了两下，又开始往前蹿。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛这时候已经过了路口，车速表懒洋洋地爬到了四十。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{120}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛这时候已经过了路口，车速表懒洋洋地爬到了四十。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “卧槽，卧槽，哥你看见没，他刚刚横过去了，尾巴都甩到隔离带上了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{122}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“卧槽，卧槽，哥你看见没，他刚刚横过去了，尾巴都甩到隔离带上了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智整个人贴在副驾驶车窗上，鼻子哈出来的雾气糊了一小片玻璃。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{124}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智整个人贴在副驾驶车窗上，鼻子哈出来的雾气糊了一小片玻璃。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “看见了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{126}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“看见了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你早知道他起不来？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{128}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你早知道他起不来？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “胎上又没长眼，油门一踹到底，后轮又是半热熔，还是零下的天。他这胎现在冻得发硬，抓个屁的地。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{130}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“胎上又没长眼，油门一踹到底，后轮又是半热熔，还是零下的天。他这胎现在冻得发硬，抓个屁的地。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一伸手把中控屏上的音量往上拧了两格，鼓点从后排的音响里一下一下敲出来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{132}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一伸手把中控屏上的音量往上拧了两格，鼓点从后排的音响里一下一下敲出来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “半热熔得热，得跑起来磨着，胎温上去了才咬地。他这一路红灯绿灯的，胎都凉透了，还想在雪上弹射起步，纯属找事儿。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{134}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“半热熔得热，得跑起来磨着，胎温上去了才咬地。他这一路红灯绿灯的，胎都凉透了，还想在雪上弹射起步，纯属找事儿。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智愣了一下，把剩下的半截烟按灭在了门板上的烟灰缸里。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{136}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智愣了一下，把剩下的半截烟按灭在了门板上的烟灰缸里。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那你刚才骂他傻X……”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{138}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那你刚才骂他傻X……”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “我骂的是实话。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{140}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“我骂的是实话。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车里安静了几秒，只剩下音响里那段被小智唱成印度米饭的旋律。雨刮器又“吱”了一声。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{142}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车里安静了几秒，只剩下音响里那段被小智唱成印度米饭的旋律。雨刮器又“吱”了一声。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “他妈的。”侯天一顺手把雨刮拨杆推了一档。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{144}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“他妈的。”侯天一顺手把雨刮拨杆推了一档。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，他追上来了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{146}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，他追上来了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一瞄了一眼后视镜。那团粉色果然又贴上来了，远光灯一晃一晃的，隔着雪花直接照进了奥德赛的后窗。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{148}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一瞄了一眼后视镜。那团粉色果然又贴上来了，远光灯一晃一晃的，隔着雪花直接照进了奥德赛的后窗。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “让他追。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{150}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“让他追。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 前方的路口又是红灯。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{152}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[前方的路口又是红灯。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一提前收了油，让车慢悠悠地滑进左边的车道，正好停在停止线后面一个车身的位置。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{154}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一提前收了油，让车慢悠悠地滑进左边的车道，正好停在停止线后面一个车身的位置。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{156}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“咕……嗡嗡！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86从右后方冲上来，刹车踩得太晚，四条轮子在雪面上锁死又松开，车头一个点头，最后斜着停在了停止线前面半米。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{158}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86从右后方冲上来，刹车踩得太晚，四条轮子在雪面上锁死又松开，车头一个点头，最后斜着停在了停止线前面半米。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 副驾驶的车窗降了下来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{160}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[副驾驶的车窗降了下来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 穿黑丝的小姐姐半个身子探出来，脸冻得发红，嘴里蹦出来的话在冷空气里带着白汽。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{162}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[穿黑丝的小姐姐半个身子探出来，脸冻得发红，嘴里蹦出来的话在冷空气里带着白汽。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “开个奶爸车装什么B，有种去环城路上跑一圈！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{164}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“开个奶爸车装什么B，有种去环城路上跑一圈！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智的手已经摸到了车窗按键上，被侯天一一把按住了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{166}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智的手已经摸到了车窗按键上，被侯天一一把按住了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{168}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “坐好。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{170}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“坐好。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一把自己这边的窗户降下一半，冷风灌进来，耳朵尖立刻有点发麻。他把身子探过去，冲着86的驾驶位喊了一句。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{172}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一把自己这边的窗户降下一半，冷风灌进来，耳朵尖立刻有点发麻。他把身子探过去，冲着86的驾驶位喊了一句。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “兄弟，前面二里地就是交警的除雪点，你这胎，过去就得被拦下来。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{174}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“兄弟，前面二里地就是交警的除雪点，你这胎，过去就得被拦下来。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86的车里一下子安静了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{176}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86的车里一下子安静了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “换套冬季胎再来玩儿，大过年的，别把车扔沟里。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{178}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“换套冬季胎再来玩儿，大过年的，别把车扔沟里。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一说完就把窗户升了上去，扭头往红绿灯上看，那边正好从三跳到了二。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{180}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一说完就把窗户升了上去，扭头往红绿灯上看，那边正好从三跳到了二。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智盯着他，眼睛眨了好几下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{182}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智盯着他，眼睛眨了好几下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，你这……就完了？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{184}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，你这……就完了？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “完了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{186}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“完了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那咖啡我还没喝够呢，我以为你要干他一把。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{188}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那咖啡我还没喝够呢，我以为你要干他一把。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “干他一把干嘛，赢一台雪地里穿半热熔的86，回去我都不好意思跟人提。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{190}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“干他一把干嘛，赢一台雪地里穿半热熔的86，回去我都不好意思跟人提。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 绿灯。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{192}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一这次连油门都没舍得多给，奥德赛慢吞吞地过了路口。86在原地愣了两秒，尾灯亮了一下，也跟着起了步，只不过这一回明显老实了很多，一直乖乖地跟在奥德赛的屁股后面。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{194}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一这次连油门都没舍得多给，奥德赛慢吞吞地过了路口。86在原地愣了两秒，尾灯亮了一下，也跟着起了步，只不过这一回明显老实了很多，一直乖乖地跟在奥德赛的屁股后面。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 到了下一个路口，那台粉色的车身打着灯拐进了右边的路，再也没有出现在后视镜里。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{196}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[到了下一个路口，那台粉色的车身打着灯拐进了右边的路，再也没有出现在后视镜里。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智靠回椅背，长长地呼出一口气，把打包杯里剩下的一点冰美式全灌了下去。杯底的冰块碰得咯咯响。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{198}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智靠回椅背，长长地呼出一口气，把打包杯里剩下的一点冰美式全灌了下去。杯底的冰块碰得咯咯响。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{200}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{202}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“嗯。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “刚在店里，我问你借车那事儿，你还没回我呢。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{204}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“刚在店里，我问你借车那事儿，你还没回我呢。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一开着车，右手在方向盘上轻轻敲了两下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{206}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一开着车，右手在方向盘上轻轻敲了两下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车过了一座桥。桥面上的雪被压成了灰黑色的冰壳，奥德赛在上面稳稳当当地走着，胎噪轻得几乎听不见。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{208}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车过了一座桥。桥面上的雪被压成了灰黑色的冰壳，奥德赛在上面稳稳当当地走着，胎噪轻得几乎听不见。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那车不好开。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{210}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那车不好开。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “不好开我练练不就好开了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{212}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“不好开我练练不就好开了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “它连ABS都没有，方向盘沉，油门踩重一脚屁股就出去了。你这刚拿本的水平，上去转两圈就得给我磕到墩子上。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{214}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“它连ABS都没有，方向盘沉，油门踩重一脚屁股就出去了。你这刚拿本的水平，上去转两圈就得给我磕到墩子上。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “什么车啊，这么多讲究。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{216}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“什么车啊，这么多讲究。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一把手伸进外套兜里，摸出了自己的钥匙串。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{218}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一把手伸进外套兜里，摸出了自己的钥匙串。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛的智能钥匙下面，还挂着一把老式的金属钥匙，钥匙柄上的黑色塑料已经磨得发亮，中间的标有点掉漆，隐约能看出一个椭圆的轮廓。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{220}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛的智能钥匙下面，还挂着一把老式的金属钥匙，钥匙柄上的黑色塑料已经磨得发亮，中间的标有点掉漆，隐约能看出一个椭圆的轮廓。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智凑过去看了一眼，喉咙动了动。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{222}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智凑过去看了一眼，喉咙动了动。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{224}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，这是……”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “明天上午我休班，带你去大伯家的老院子看看。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{226}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“明天上午我休班，带你去大伯家的老院子看看。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一把钥匙串塞回兜里，顺手在中控屏上把歌切回了第一首。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{228}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一把钥匙串塞回兜里，顺手在中控屏上把歌切回了第一首。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “它在那趴了三年了，电瓶得先搭一下。你要真想开，先学会把离合踩明白。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{230}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“它在那趴了三年了，电瓶得先搭一下。你要真想开，先学会把离合踩明白。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 窗外的小雪还在下，曹州城的路灯一根一根地往后退。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{232}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[窗外的小雪还在下，曹州城的路灯一根一根地往后退。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智把空了的打包杯捏得咔咔响，脑子里那个椭圆的车标怎么也甩不出去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:07:09.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:07:28.000Z" objectID="{505C15EF-5E2E-413C-8C6C-4F2925B14280}{234}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智把空了的打包杯捏得咔咔响，脑子里那个椭圆的车标怎么也甩不出去。]]></one:T></one:OE>
