paragraphs.text: 绿灯跳了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{24}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯跳了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一的右脚比脑子先动。CVT这东西从来不跟人撒娇，转速爬到两千四百多就稳住了，奥德赛车头一抬，带着两个人和后座那一摞没卸的杯具往前拱。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{26}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一的右脚比脑子先动。CVT这东西从来不跟人撒娇，转速爬到两千四百多就稳住了，奥德赛车头一抬，带着两个人和后座那一摞没卸的杯具往前拱。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 身后传来一声闷响，是后轮拍打轮拱。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{28}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[身后传来一声闷响，是后轮拍打轮拱。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那台粉色86在雪面上原地刨出两个黑洞，车尾左右甩了一下，才勉强把车身甩出去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{30}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那台粉色86在雪面上原地刨出两个黑洞，车尾左右甩了一下，才勉强把车身甩出去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「卧槽。」小智手里的打包杯晃了一下，冰块撞在杯壁上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{32}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「卧槽。」小智手里的打包杯晃了一下，冰块撞在杯壁上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「安全带勒紧。」侯天一盯着前车距，「后驱，冷胎，胎面没排水槽。这一身装备在雪地里就是块砖。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{34}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「安全带勒紧。」侯天一盯着前车距，「后驱，冷胎，胎面没排水槽。这一身装备在雪地里就是块砖。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 雪花贴着挡风玻璃扑上来，雨刮器跑到尽头就吱一声。侯天一伸手把它按回间歇档最低那一格。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{36}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[雪花贴着挡风玻璃扑上来，雨刮器跑到尽头就吱一声。侯天一伸手把它按回间歇档最低那一格。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 中控里鼓点已经铺开了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{38}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[中控里鼓点已经铺开了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 《Deja Vu》。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{40}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[《Deja Vu》。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「哥，这就放上了？」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{42}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「哥，这就放上了？」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「仪式感。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{44}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「仪式感。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 第一个路口前面压着三台车。侯天一点了一脚刹车，速度掉到四十，方向盘跟着往右带了半分。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{46}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[第一个路口前面压着三台车。侯天一点了一脚刹车，速度掉到四十，方向盘跟着往右带了半分。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛挤进了建材市场中间那条道。两侧全是堆在门口的瓷砖垛，吊顶的灯牌在雪里糊成一片黄。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{48}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛挤进了建材市场中间那条道。两侧全是堆在门口的瓷砖垛，吊顶的灯牌在雪里糊成一片黄。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「这能过？」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{50}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「这能过？」]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{52}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「能。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车头擦着一辆三轮的把手过去，小智把身子缩到扶手箱后面，眉毛都挤到一起。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{54}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车头擦着一辆三轮的把手过去，小智把身子缩到扶手箱后面，眉毛都挤到一起。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「哥，恁这是要干啥，咱就是一台MPV，咱回家不行吗。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{56}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「哥，恁这是要干啥，咱就是一台MPV，咱回家不行吗。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「他追上来了一台，我怎么办，我停车让他骂我两句？」侯天一眼睛扫着后视镜，「前头这段路没监控。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{58}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「他追上来了一台，我怎么办，我停车让他骂我两句？」侯天一眼睛扫着后视镜，「前头这段路没监控。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智愣了一下，脑袋从扶手箱后面抬起来，鼻尖蹭在车窗玻璃上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{60}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智愣了一下，脑袋从扶手箱后面抬起来，鼻尖蹭在车窗玻璃上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「卧槽，你懂的真多。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{62}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「卧槽，你懂的真多。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「我在这座城市开了六年车。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{64}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「我在这座城市开了六年车。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 建材市场尽头是一段上坡，坡口停着一辆正在卸货的厢货，双闪一亮一灭。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{66}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[建材市场尽头是一段上坡，坡口停着一辆正在卸货的厢货，双闪一亮一灭。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一提前三秒松了油门，方向盘压到道路左侧，从厢货和花坛那条不到一米五的缝里蹭了过去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{68}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一提前三秒松了油门，方向盘压到道路左侧，从厢货和花坛那条不到一米五的缝里蹭了过去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 右侧后视镜折到了车身，奥德赛的车头歪了一下，又正回来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{70}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[右侧后视镜折到了车身，奥德赛的车头歪了一下，又正回来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「啊……」小智的后脑勺磕在头枕上，那杯冰美式顺着杯壁流了一截到裤腿上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{72}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「啊……」小智的后脑勺磕在头枕上，那杯冰美式顺着杯壁流了一截到裤腿上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没接话，右手把中控的音量拧大了两格。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{74}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一没接话，右手把中控的音量拧大了两格。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 上了河堤路，路面被推土机扫出两道黑印子，中间剩一层薄冰。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{76}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[上了河堤路，路面被推土机扫出两道黑印子，中间剩一层薄冰。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一把挡位从D推到了手动模式，降了两档。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{78}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一把挡位从D推到了手动模式，降了两档。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「你干嘛。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{80}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「你干嘛。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「发动机制动，前面那段下坡有黑冰，踩刹车就转。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{82}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「发动机制动，前面那段下坡有黑冰，踩刹车就转。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「你咋知道有黑冰？」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{84}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「你咋知道有黑冰？」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「我天天这个点从这儿回。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{86}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「我天天这个点从这儿回。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车尾巴一沉，奥德赛顺着坡滑下去，速度稳在五十出头。侯天一的右脚始终虚搭在刹车上方，没真踩下去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{88}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车尾巴一沉，奥德赛顺着坡滑下去，速度稳在五十出头。侯天一的右脚始终虚搭在刹车上方，没真踩下去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 后桥上那层冰被压出咔一声脆响。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{90}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[后桥上那层冰被压出咔一声脆响。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智的手死死抠着扶手上那个把手，手心湿了，指头肚打滑。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{92}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智的手死死抠着扶手上那个把手，手心湿了，指头肚打滑。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 坡底的路灯下，一台粉色的东西正从河堤另一头上来，前大灯拉出两条长长的白。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{94}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[坡底的路灯下，一台粉色的东西正从河堤另一头上来，前大灯拉出两条长长的白。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「他他他……」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{96}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「他他他……」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「看见他了。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{98}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「看见他了。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 半热熔胎跑热了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{100}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[半热熔胎跑热了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 这一点侯天一早就知道。前段那两公里他抢的是路，不是车。这会儿86的胎温上来了，抓地力回来了，车头压过路面没有一点多余的动作，跟涂了胶水一样。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{102}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[这一点侯天一早就知道。前段那两公里他抢的是路，不是车。这会儿86的胎温上来了，抓地力回来了，车头压过路面没有一点多余的动作，跟涂了胶水一样。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 两台车在滨河路的第一盏红灯前并排停住。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{104}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[两台车在滨河路的第一盏红灯前并排停住。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车窗都摇下来一半。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{106}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车窗都摇下来一半。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「你他妈还没完没了了是吧？」86那个男的喊，帽子压得低，嘴里一股子烟味。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{108}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「你他妈还没完没了了是吧？」86那个男的喊，帽子压得低，嘴里一股子烟味。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 副驾驶那个黑丝姑娘手里举着手机，镜头对着奥德赛的牌照。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{110}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[副驾驶那个黑丝姑娘手里举着手机，镜头对着奥德赛的牌照。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「哥，她在拍咱们。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{112}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「哥，她在拍咱们。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「拍呗。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{114}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「拍呗。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一走神了三秒钟，扭头看了一眼那个手机壳。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{116}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一走神了三秒钟，扭头看了一眼那个手机壳。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 绿灯亮。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{118}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯亮。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛先动。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{120}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛先动。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「小智，坐正。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{122}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「小智，坐正。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「你要干啥。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{124}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「你要干啥。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「前面两个路口我赌他不敢跟。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{126}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「前面两个路口我赌他不敢跟。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 第一个路口他闯了黄灯尾巴。第二个路口他拐进了一条挂着单行线路牌的老巷子。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{128}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[第一个路口他闯了黄灯尾巴。第二个路口他拐进了一条挂着单行线路牌的老巷子。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智的叫声卡在嗓子里，头往后一仰，靠在座椅上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{130}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智的叫声卡在嗓子里，头往后一仰，靠在座椅上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「单行！这是单行！哥！这是单行线！」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{132}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「单行！这是单行！哥！这是单行线！」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「晚上八点到九点这一段放行，菜市场收摊以后车进不来，写牌子的人自己都忘了。」侯天一的语气跟报咖啡豆产地一样平，「我送外卖那年天天走。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{134}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「晚上八点到九点这一段放行，菜市场收摊以后车进不来，写牌子的人自己都忘了。」侯天一的语气跟报咖啡豆产地一样平，「我送外卖那年天天走。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 巷子窄，两侧后视镜离墙各一拳。雪片子从两家楼中间的缝里往下掉，掉在挡风玻璃上化成一道一道的。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{136}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[巷子窄，两侧后视镜离墙各一拳。雪片子从两家楼中间的缝里往下掉，掉在挡风玻璃上化成一道一道的。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 巷尾果然停着两台交警的电动车，一个辅警正弯腰给一辆电动三轮贴罚单。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{138}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[巷尾果然停着两台交警的电动车，一个辅警正弯腰给一辆电动三轮贴罚单。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一在距离那三个人二十米的地方把车速压到三十，右手顺手把中控屏上的《Deja Vu》按了暂停，抬手冲那边点了一下头。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{140}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一在距离那三个人二十米的地方把车速压到三十，右手顺手把中控屏上的《Deja Vu》按了暂停，抬手冲那边点了一下头。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「哟，李哥，下班啊。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{142}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「哟，李哥，下班啊。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「哟，天一，这么晚呐。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{144}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「哟，天一，这么晚呐。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛平稳地从两个人身边开过去，车速表指针一动没动。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{146}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛平稳地从两个人身边开过去，车速表指针一动没动。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智的嘴巴张着，半天没合上，喉结上下滚了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{148}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智的嘴巴张着，半天没合上，喉结上下滚了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「你，你认识。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{150}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「你，你认识。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「我在这城市混了二十六年。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{152}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「我在这城市混了二十六年。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「那你刚才吓我？」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{154}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「那你刚才吓我？」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「我没吓你，我在弄他。」侯天一指了指引擎盖的方向，「他追单行线，就得绕整个菜市街，多八百米加一个红灯。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{156}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「我没吓你，我在弄他。」侯天一指了指引擎盖的方向，「他追单行线，就得绕整个菜市街，多八百米加一个红灯。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车停了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{158}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车停了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小区闸门口的雪被扫成一堆，奥德赛停在门岗灯下面，粉色86横在侧前方，车头几乎顶到奥德赛的右前角。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{160}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小区闸门口的雪被扫成一堆，奥德赛停在门岗灯下面，粉色86横在侧前方，车头几乎顶到奥德赛的右前角。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那个男的下车的时候帽子掉了，脑袋上顶着一层汗，头发比小智的还乱。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{162}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那个男的下车的时候帽子掉了，脑袋上顶着一层汗，头发比小智的还乱。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那姑娘坐在副驾上没动，手机举着，直播间的人数还在往上跳。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{164}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那姑娘坐在副驾上没动，手机举着，直播间的人数还在往上跳。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「下来，说清楚。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{166}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「下来，说清楚。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一推门，雪立刻灌进领口，他没缩脖子。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{168}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一推门，雪立刻灌进领口，他没缩脖子。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智缩在车里，只把脑袋伸出来一条缝，看着自己哥走到那人跟前，两个人额头离得很近。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{170}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智缩在车里，只把脑袋伸出来一条缝，看着自己哥走到那人跟前，两个人额头离得很近。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那人说了句什么，声音被风切掉了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{172}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那人说了句什么，声音被风切掉了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一答了一句，很轻，但闸门里值班的保安都听见了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{174}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一答了一句，很轻，但闸门里值班的保安都听见了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「你车撞我车了，赔钱。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{176}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「你车撞我车了，赔钱。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「你他妈知道我是谁吗？」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{178}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「你他妈知道我是谁吗？」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「我不知道，我也不想知道。」侯天一点了一根白将军，烟头在雪里亮了一下，「你老婆在直播，你自己看她镜头。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{180}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「我不知道，我也不想知道。」侯天一点了一根白将军，烟头在雪里亮了一下，「你老婆在直播，你自己看她镜头。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那男的扭头。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{182}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那男的扭头。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 副驾驶那块屏幕在雪夜里特别亮，弹幕刷得飞快，最上面一行写着在线人数六万八。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{184}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[副驾驶那块屏幕在雪夜里特别亮，弹幕刷得飞快，最上面一行写着在线人数六万八。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「曹州本地86一哥，今天被奥德赛遛了？」侯天一吐了一口气，「这标题我给你想好了。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{186}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「曹州本地86一哥，今天被奥德赛遛了？」侯天一吐了一口气，「这标题我给你想好了。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那男的手抬起来一半。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{188}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那男的手抬起来一半。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一低头看表，没躲。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{190}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一低头看表，没躲。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 手停住了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{192}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[手停住了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「多少钱。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{194}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「多少钱。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「三万八。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{196}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「三万八。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「你他妈抢……」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{198}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「你他妈抢……」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「一万二。」侯天一让了让，「大过年的，我给你留两千买豆子。」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{200}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「一万二。」侯天一让了让，「大过年的，我给你留两千买豆子。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智在后面听得眼皮直跳，胃里往上顶，一股凉气顺着尾椎往下走。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{202}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智在后面听得眼皮直跳，胃里往上顶，一股凉气顺着尾椎往下走。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 微信转账的声音在风里响了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{204}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[微信转账的声音在风里响了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那男的收了手机，拉开车门，座舱里传出一股热乎乎的香水味。奥德赛倒出去的时候，粉色86一动不动，尾灯红着。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{206}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那男的收了手机，拉开车门，座舱里传出一股热乎乎的香水味。奥德赛倒出去的时候，粉色86一动不动，尾灯红着。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{208}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「哥。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{210}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「嗯。」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 「你以前是不是也玩这个？」
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{212}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[「你以前是不是也玩这个？」]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没答，把车开进了地库，拐到最里面那一排车位前，熄了火。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{214}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一没答，把车开进了地库，拐到最里面那一排车位前，熄了火。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 灯管一根一根亮起来，照出一个靠墙的独立车位。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{216}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[灯管一根一根亮起来，照出一个靠墙的独立车位。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车位上罩着一块车衣，灰色，落了厚厚一层灰，边角用两根橡皮筋勒着。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{218}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车位上罩着一块车衣，灰色，落了厚厚一层灰，边角用两根橡皮筋勒着。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智咽了口唾沫。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{220}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智咽了口唾沫。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一下车，走到车衣前面，手放在下摆那根拉绳上，停了大概有五秒钟。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{222}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一下车，走到车衣前面，手放在下摆那根拉绳上，停了大概有五秒钟。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 风从地库通风口灌进来，车衣下摆被掀起一小角。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{224}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[风从地库通风口灌进来，车衣下摆被掀起一小角。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 一小片粉色的漆露出来，边上带着一道没处理干净的旧伤。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{226}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[一小片粉色的漆露出来，边上带着一道没处理干净的旧伤。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智的手机在兜里震了三下，家族群那一条视频被二伯转发进来，标题只有一个字。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:17:29.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:17:37.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{228}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智的手机在兜里震了三下，家族群那一条视频被二伯转发进来，标题只有一个字。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 绿灯亮。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{245}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯亮。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{247}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "轰。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{249}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["轰。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{251}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86先响。车头往上一抬，排气管在雪夜里炸出一声闷响。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{253}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86先响。车头往上一抬，排气管在雪夜里炸出一声闷响。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{33D3CAAD-8BC9-4F68-A3CF-88D0856D7BEE}{255}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 紧接着车尾就横了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{11}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[紧接着车尾就横了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{13}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 粉色车漆在路灯下甩出半道弧线，后轮在薄雪上疯狂空转，卷起一片白雾。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{15}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[粉色车漆在路灯下甩出半道弧线，后轮在薄雪上疯狂空转，卷起一片白雾。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 半热熔胎吃不上温度，这时候就是两块擦地的硬橡皮。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{19}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[半热熔胎吃不上温度，这时候就是两块擦地的硬橡皮。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{21}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{27}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智能看见那两道尾灯在雪里划出的红线。]]></one:T></one:OE>
