paragraphs.text: "咳！咳咳……"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{35}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["咳！咳咳……"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{37}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 他一手抓门板，一手够头顶拉手，肩膀被安全带死死摁住。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{39}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[他一手抓门板，一手够头顶拉手，肩膀被安全带死死摁住。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{41}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哥！他转了！他原地转圈了！"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{43}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哥！他转了！他原地转圈了！"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{45}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没吭声。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{47}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一没吭声。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{49}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛还在原地。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{51}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛还在原地。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{53}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 脚尖压着油门，压下去半寸，转速懒洋洋爬到一千五。CVT低温发黏，车身只是稳稳往前挪。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{55}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[脚尖压着油门，压下去半寸，转速懒洋洋爬到一千五。CVT低温发黏，车身只是稳稳往前挪。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{57}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智已经把脸贴到了玻璃上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{59}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智已经把脸贴到了玻璃上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{61}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86歪在两条车道中间，车头指着斜前方。车主反打方向，前轮救回来一点，后轮又开始挠。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{63}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86歪在两条车道中间，车头指着斜前方。车主反打方向，前轮救回来一点，后轮又开始挠。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{65}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 雪地被刨出两道黑印。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{67}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[雪地被刨出两道黑印。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{69}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 副驾那只手从车窗里伸出来，指着侯天一这边，骂的话被玻璃挡得只剩口型。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{71}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[副驾那只手从车窗里伸出来，指着侯天一这边，骂的话被玻璃挡得只剩口型。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{73}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一瞥了眼后视镜。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{75}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一瞥了眼后视镜。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{77}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 后颈一层薄汗，被空调风一吹，凉得发痒。他把咖啡塞进杯架，右手在裤子上蹭了蹭。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{79}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[后颈一层薄汗，被空调风一吹，凉得发痒。他把咖啡塞进杯架，右手在裤子上蹭了蹭。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{81}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "翁。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{83}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["翁。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{85}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛从86旁边滑过去，四十出头。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{87}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛从86旁边滑过去，四十出头。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{89}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智扭着脖子往后看。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{91}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智扭着脖子往后看。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哈哈哈哥！他还在刨！"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{95}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哈哈哈哥！他还在刨！"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{97}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一把驾驶位玻璃降到底。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{99}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一把驾驶位玻璃降到底。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{101}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 冷风灌进来，雪片糊在脸颊上，凉得他眼皮一跳。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{103}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[冷风灌进来，雪片糊在脸颊上，凉得他眼皮一跳。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{105}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86车主也把窗放下来，脸涨得通红。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{107}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86车主也把窗放下来，脸涨得通红。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{109}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "你他妈看什么看！"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{111}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["你他妈看什么看！"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{113}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一歪头看了眼那两条后轮。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{115}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一歪头看了眼那两条后轮。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{117}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哥们儿。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{119}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哥们儿。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{121}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "你胎热了没有？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{123}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["你胎热了没有？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{125}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "雪天套半热熔，前驱还敢弹射。你这是拿命换抓地力。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{127}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["雪天套半热熔，前驱还敢弹射。你这是拿命换抓地力。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{129}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86车主愣了半秒，骂声卡在嗓子眼里。副驾那位把手缩了回去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{131}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86车主愣了半秒，骂声卡在嗓子眼里。副驾那位把手缩了回去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{133}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一升窗。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{135}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一升窗。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{137}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 玻璃升到一半，他又按停，探头补了一句。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{139}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[玻璃升到一半，他又按停，探头补了一句。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{141}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "牛逼。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{143}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["牛逼。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{145}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 玻璃合上。车里那首歌正到鼓点。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{147}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[玻璃合上。车里那首歌正到鼓点。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{149}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智在副驾上笑得直拍大腿。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{151}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智在副驾上笑得直拍大腿。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{153}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "我操哥，你看到他脸了没有，跟吃了屎一样。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{155}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["我操哥，你看到他脸了没有，跟吃了屎一样。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{157}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一嘴角动了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{159}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一嘴角动了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{161}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "他骂我我都没还嘴。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{163}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["他骂我我都没还嘴。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{165}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "你那是没还嘴？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{167}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["你那是没还嘴？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{169}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "那叫讲道理。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{171}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["那叫讲道理。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{173}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智吸了吸鼻子，把安全带松了一扣。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{175}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智吸了吸鼻子，把安全带松了一扣。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{177}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哥，我刚真以为你要跟他崩。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{179}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哥，我刚真以为你要跟他崩。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{181}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没接。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{183}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一没接。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{185}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 红灯最后那三秒，他脑子里过的全是大年初二的事。六口人塞进后两排，后备箱还得塞两箱酒。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{187}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[红灯最后那三秒，他脑子里过的全是大年初二的事。六口人塞进后两排，后备箱还得塞两箱酒。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{189}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 这台奥德赛是拿来拉人的。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{191}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[这台奥德赛是拿来拉人的。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{193}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车厢里还飘着白将军的烟味，混着杯里那点瑰夏的酸香。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{195}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车厢里还飘着白将军的烟味，混着杯里那点瑰夏的酸香。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{197}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智的手心在出汗，他往裤子上抹了两把。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{199}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智的手心在出汗，他往裤子上抹了两把。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{201}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 雪片砸在挡风上，雨刮器还在吱吱叫。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{203}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[雪片砸在挡风上，雨刮器还在吱吱叫。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{E2C73DE2-692A-44A1-AC5E-59DF4BCDBF42}{205}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "妈的，明天去换。"

paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{17}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["雪天，半热熔，前驱。他起步不打滑才怪。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{19}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "那要是你开那台86，你咋起步？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{21}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["那要是你开那台86，你咋起步？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{23}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一沉默了两秒。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{25}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一沉默了两秒。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{27}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "二挡起步。油门喂一半。出弯以前别动方向。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{29}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["二挡起步。油门喂一半。出弯以前别动方向。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{31}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智愣住。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{33}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智愣住。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{35}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "你开过？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{37}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["你开过？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{39}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "我朋友的，借来遛过两圈。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{41}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["我朋友的，借来遛过两圈。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{43}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "……牛逼。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{45}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["……牛逼。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{47}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车里那首歌放到尾声，鼓点收了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{49}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车里那首歌放到尾声，鼓点收了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{51}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智忽然又想起来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{53}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智忽然又想起来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{55}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哥，那老车的事儿，你还没回我呢。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{57}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哥，那老车的事儿，你还没回我呢。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{59}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一的手指在方向盘上敲了两下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{61}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一的手指在方向盘上敲了两下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{63}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "那车在老院子，盖着车衣，放了三年。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{65}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["那车在老院子，盖着车衣，放了三年。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{67}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "啥车啊？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{69}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["啥车啊？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{71}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "明天跟我去看看。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{73}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["明天跟我去看看。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{75}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "你倒是说啊！"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{77}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["你倒是说啊！"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{79}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一偏头看他一眼。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{81}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一偏头看他一眼。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{83}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "电瓶肯定没了。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{85}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["电瓶肯定没了。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{87}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "我问的是啥车！"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{89}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["我问的是啥车！"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{91}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没再说话，把音量拧大了一格。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{93}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一没再说话，把音量拧大了一格。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{95}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛拐过路口，尾灯融进一街的红色刹车灯里。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{97}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛拐过路口，尾灯融进一街的红色刹车灯里。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{99}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 雪还在下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:04.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{101}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[雪还在下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: Devin Opus 5
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml:
<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:47.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:51.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{149}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:16.0pt;
color:black" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[Devin Opus 5]]></one:T></one:OE>
