<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:43.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:43.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{152}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'Noto Sans SC Black';font-size:16.0pt;
color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 绿灯亮了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{210}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:Inter;font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯亮了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一的右脚没有猛下去，油门匀匀压到一半。奥德赛的变速箱轻轻顿了一下，车头端端正正地往前推。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{212}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一的右脚没有猛下去，油门匀匀压到一半。奥德赛的变速箱轻轻顿了一下，车头端端正正地往前推。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 旁边那声“瓮”比刚才任何一脚都响。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{214}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[旁边那声“瓮”比刚才任何一脚都响。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86的尾巴先动了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{216}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86的尾巴先动了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 两条半热熔在雪水里空转，连白烟都没起来，只甩出一片脏雪浆，车屁股横着往奥德赛这边蹭过来半个身位。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{218}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[两条半热熔在雪水里空转，连白烟都没起来，只甩出一片脏雪浆，车屁股横着往奥德赛这边蹭过来半个身位。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智的额头差点撞上A柱。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{220}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智的额头差点撞上A柱。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “操！他要贴上来了！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{222}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“操！他要贴上来了！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一往左掰了小半圈方向，又立刻回正，奥德赛擦着86的车头蹿出去五六米。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{224}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一往左掰了小半圈方向，又立刻回正，奥德赛擦着86的车头蹿出去五六米。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 后视镜里，那台粉车还在原地打摆子。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{226}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[后视镜里，那台粉车还在原地打摆子。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 轮胎干嚎，车身左右晃了三四下，才终于把地面咬住。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{228}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[轮胎干嚎，车身左右晃了三四下，才终于把地面咬住。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “……”小智回过头，嘴张着，半天没合上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{230}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“……”小智回过头，嘴张着，半天没合上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{232}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{234}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“嗯。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “他刚才那是要干啥？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{236}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“他刚才那是要干啥？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “他想干啥他自己也不知道。”侯天一把暖风往下调了一格，风口的热气正吹得他眼睛干，“我跟你说了，这个天气套半热熔上街的，都是傻X。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{238}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“他想干啥他自己也不知道。”侯天一把暖风往下调了一格，风口的热气正吹得他眼睛干，“我跟你说了，这个天气套半热熔上街的，都是傻X。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “可他那胎不是抓地更强吗？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{240}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“可他那胎不是抓地更强吗？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “热了才强。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{242}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“热了才强。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一伸手在中控屏上把歌曲往后跳了一首，节奏一下顶起来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{244}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一伸手在中控屏上把歌曲往后跳了一首，节奏一下顶起来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “半热熔得跑到七八十度才有活儿，这会儿地表零下，雪水一浸，那玩意儿比塑料还滑。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{246}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“半热熔得跑到七八十度才有活儿，这会儿地表零下，雪水一浸，那玩意儿比塑料还滑。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “他刚才要是再多给一点油，直接就转过去了，一头怼绿化带。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{248}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“他刚才要是再多给一点油，直接就转过去了，一头怼绿化带。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那他怼了吗？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{250}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那他怼了吗？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “没怼。”侯天一笑了一下，“怼了咱们就得等交警了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{252}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“没怼。”侯天一笑了一下，“怼了咱们就得等交警了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智把冰美式往怀里搂了搂，吸管咬在牙上，咯咯地响。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{A9CB42EB-FC60-4908-B271-9BC63261478F}{254}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智把冰美式往怀里搂了搂，吸管咬在牙上，咯咯地响。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 杯子里的冰块撞着杯壁，跟着车底的雪路一块儿颠。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{10}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[杯子里的冰块撞着杯壁，跟着车底的雪路一块儿颠。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 前面又是一个红灯。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{12}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[前面又是一个红灯。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一松了油门，滑行了几十米，刹车踩得很轻，奥德赛稳稳停在白线里。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{14}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一松了油门，滑行了几十米，刹车踩得很轻，奥德赛稳稳停在白线里。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智还在回味刚才那半个身位。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{16}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智还在回味刚才那半个身位。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，我算是明白了，你刚才那一脚根本没使劲儿。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{18}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，我算是明白了，你刚才那一脚根本没使劲儿。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “我使劲儿干什么，我是奥德赛。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{20}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“我使劲儿干什么，我是奥德赛。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那你逗他?”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{22}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那你逗他?”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “我按规矩起步。”侯天一把手搭回方向盘上边，“他自己滑的，我一根手指头都没碰他。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{24}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“我按规矩起步。”侯天一把手搭回方向盘上边，“他自己滑的，我一根手指头都没碰他。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 后视镜里两束灯光晃过来，粉色的车影贴着奥德赛左边停下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{26}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[后视镜里两束灯光晃过来，粉色的车影贴着奥德赛左边停下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 窗户降了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{28}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[窗户降了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那位黑丝小姐姐半个身子探出来，风把她的头发往车里灌，嘴里骂的什么被雪声吃掉一半。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{30}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那位黑丝小姐姐半个身子探出来，风把她的头发往车里灌，嘴里骂的什么被雪声吃掉一半。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智立马就要摇窗，手已经按在门板的开关上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{32}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智立马就要摇窗，手已经按在门板的开关上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “别动。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{34}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“别动。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥！她刚才那个手势！”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{36}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥！她刚才那个手势！”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “我看见了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{38}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“我看见了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一自己把主驾的窗户摇了下来，寒气瞬间灌满了整个车厢，扑得他后脖子一紧。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{40}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一自己把主驾的窗户摇了下来，寒气瞬间灌满了整个车厢，扑得他后脖子一紧。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 他没吵。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{42}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[他没吵。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 他伸出一根手指，往前方指了指。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{44}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[他伸出一根手指，往前方指了指。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “姑娘，前头三百米路口有交警扫雪，两台车在那儿摆着呢。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{46}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“姑娘，前头三百米路口有交警扫雪，两台车在那儿摆着呢。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你们这胎，压着雪那一脚下去，他都不用拦你，你自己就得贴上去。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{48}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你们这胎，压着雪那一脚下去，他都不用拦你，你自己就得贴上去。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 对面的人愣住了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{50}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[对面的人愣住了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86的驾驶座上那个小伙子把身子压过来，脸从副驾窗口挤出半张，语气软了一截。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{52}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86的驾驶座上那个小伙子把身子压过来，脸从副驾窗口挤出半张，语气软了一截。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥你懂车啊？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{54}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥你懂车啊？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “懂一点。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{56}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“懂一点。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “我这胎是……”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{58}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“我这胎是……”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “半热熔，我知道。”侯天一把窗户摇上去一半，只留一条缝，“回家换一套四季胎，等到四月份再套上来。这车没ABS的脾气，你前两天要是在高架上遇到湿雪，你就没有今天这个机会跟我聊天了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{60}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“半热熔，我知道。”侯天一把窗户摇上去一半，只留一条缝，“回家换一套四季胎，等到四月份再套上来。这车没ABS的脾气，你前两天要是在高架上遇到湿雪，你就没有今天这个机会跟我聊天了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 绿灯。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{62}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一先起步，比刚才还慢。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{64}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一先起步，比刚才还慢。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86在后边跟了两个路口，一直没敢再踩下去，最后拐进了一条小路。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{66}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86在后边跟了两个路口，一直没敢再踩下去，最后拐进了一条小路。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “怂了。”小智把吸管从嘴里拔出来，往杯盖上一点，“妈的，我还想着跟他理论理论。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{68}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“怂了。”小智把吸管从嘴里拔出来，往杯盖上一点，“妈的，我还想着跟他理论理论。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你跟他理论完，明天大年三十，你在医院还是在派出所？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{70}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你跟他理论完，明天大年三十，你在医院还是在派出所？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “……哥你这就是不敢。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{72}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“……哥你这就是不敢。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “对，我不敢。”侯天一答得特别痛快。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{74}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“对，我不敢。”侯天一答得特别痛快。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车厢里安静了一会儿。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{76}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车厢里安静了一会儿。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 音响里那段旋律正在爬升，鼓点密得像雪打铁皮。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{78}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[音响里那段旋律正在爬升，鼓点密得像雪打铁皮。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智偷偷看了一眼他哥。侯天一整个人陷在座椅里，一只手松松搭在方向盘下边，手指跟着节拍在皮子上点，点得特别准。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{80}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智偷偷看了一眼他哥。侯天一整个人陷在座椅里，一只手松松搭在方向盘下边，手指跟着节拍在皮子上点，点得特别准。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那是他自己都不知道的习惯。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{82}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那是他自己都不知道的习惯。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 雪下大了些。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{84}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[雪下大了些。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 雨刮器又开始“吱”，侯天一伸手把档位从间隔调到低速，声音反倒更明显了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{86}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[雨刮器又开始“吱”，侯天一伸手把档位从间隔调到低速，声音反倒更明显了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{88}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“操。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，你不是最听不了这个声儿吗。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{90}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，你不是最听不了这个声儿吗。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “听不了也得听，明天初一往后修车的都放假了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{92}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“听不了也得听，明天初一往后修车的都放假了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛下了主路，拐进老城的胡同，两边的红灯笼被雪压得直不起腰。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{94}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛下了主路，拐进老城的胡同，两边的红灯笼被雪压得直不起腰。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一在一处卷帘门前停住，没有熄火。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{96}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一在一处卷帘门前停住，没有熄火。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “到了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{98}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“到了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “到哪儿了？这不是咱奶院子后头吗，你家在南边啊。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{100}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“到哪儿了？这不是咱奶院子后头吗，你家在南边啊。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没答话，从档把旁边的储物格里摸出一串钥匙，在小智眼前晃了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{102}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一没答话，从档把旁边的储物格里摸出一串钥匙，在小智眼前晃了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 三把钥匙。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{104}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[三把钥匙。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 一把是店里的后门，一把是他家防盗门，第三把的齿都磨圆了，钥匙头上贴着一块椭圆形的塑料片，边角掰掉了一个口。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{106}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[一把是店里的后门，一把是他家防盗门，第三把的齿都磨圆了，钥匙头上贴着一块椭圆形的塑料片，边角掰掉了一个口。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那上面的漆早就磨没了，只剩一个凹进去的印子。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{108}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那上面的漆早就磨没了，只剩一个凹进去的印子。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智盯着那个椭圆，喉咙咽了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{110}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智盯着那个椭圆，喉咙咽了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{112}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{114}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“嗯。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “这个标……”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{116}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“这个标……”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你不是要借老车练手吗。”侯天一把钥匙塞进他手心里，自己推开车门下了车，雪立刻落满了他的鸭舌帽檐。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{118}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你不是要借老车练手吗。”侯天一把钥匙塞进他手心里，自己推开车门下了车，雪立刻落满了他的鸭舌帽檐。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “下来。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{120}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“下来。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 卷帘门的锁冻得死硬，侯天一往手心里吐了口气，搓了搓，用两根手指捏着锁芯来回转。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{122}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[卷帘门的锁冻得死硬，侯天一往手心里吐了口气，搓了搓，用两根手指捏着锁芯来回转。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{124}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“咔。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 他弯下腰，手指抠住卷帘门底下的铁边，往上一提。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{126}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[他弯下腰，手指抠住卷帘门底下的铁边，往上一提。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 铁皮被冻住了，只起来半尺，里面的黑暗顺着那道缝往外淌。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{128}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[铁皮被冻住了，只起来半尺，里面的黑暗顺着那道缝往外淌。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 一股柴油味、机油味、还有旧地毯发霉的味儿，混在一起冲了出来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{130}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[一股柴油味、机油味、还有旧地毯发霉的味儿，混在一起冲了出来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没抬头，只把肩膀顶上去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{132}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一没抬头，只把肩膀顶上去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “小智，你过来搭把手。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{134}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“小智，你过来搭把手。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “这门有点沉。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:22:22.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:22:29.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{136}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" style="font-family:'SF Pro Text';font-size:16.0pt;color:black" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“这门有点沉。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: muse spark 1.3 oc zen free

paragraphs.text: 绿灯在漫天雪渣子里猛地亮了起来，音响里的鼓点正好砸在拍子上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{159}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯在漫天雪渣子里猛地亮了起来，音响里的鼓点正好砸在拍子上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{161}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一松刹车给油一气呵成，奥德赛车头猛地往上一窜直接扑了出去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{163}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一松刹车给油一气呵成，奥德赛车头猛地往上一窜直接扑了出去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{165}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 右侧传来一阵尖利的轮胎空转声，粉色86的后轮在雪水里刨出两道白烟。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{167}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[右侧传来一阵尖利的轮胎空转声，粉色86的后轮在雪水里刨出两道白烟。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{169}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智后背被座椅狠狠推了一把，手里那杯冰美式晃出来全洒在了袖口上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{171}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智后背被座椅狠狠推了一把，手里那杯冰美式晃出来全洒在了袖口上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{173}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一眼睛死死盯着前方湿滑的路面，右脚把油门又往深里送了半寸。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{175}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一眼睛死死盯着前方湿滑的路面，右脚把油门又往深里送了半寸。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{177}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 发动机吼声顺着地板烫进小腿肚里，嘴里叼着的白将军跟着抖了三抖。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{179}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[发动机吼声顺着地板烫进小腿肚里，嘴里叼着的白将军跟着抖了三抖。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{181}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥你慢点开啊，前面还有铲雪车在撒盐作业，雪大路滑看不清道啊。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{183}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥你慢点开啊，前面还有铲雪车在撒盐作业，雪大路滑看不清道啊。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{185}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一咧嘴笑了笑，伸手把音量又拧大两格，鼓点震得后视镜嗡嗡作响。

paragraphs.text: 胃里那口冰美式凉得往上返，他想喊又喊不出来，只能死死抠住门把手。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{203}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[胃里那口冰美式凉得往上返，他想喊又喊不出来，只能死死抠住门把手。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{205}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “追上来了哥，他们追上来了，副驾那娘们还在对咱们竖中指呢。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{207}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“追上来了哥，他们追上来了，副驾那娘们还在对咱们竖中指呢。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{209}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一瞥了一眼转速表，手指在方向盘上敲着拍子，嘴角忍不住往上翘。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{211}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一瞥了一眼转速表，手指在方向盘上敲着拍子，嘴角忍不住往上翘。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{213}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86的排气浪顶着风压了过来，轰隆隆的声浪盖住了奥德赛的音响。

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{225}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一动了动肩膀重新换了个坐姿，左脚往死里抵住脚踏板稳住身体。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:27:27.000Z" objectID="{7DFE5622-6ED7-4130-B3C4-B371413E86EB}{227}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一动了动肩膀重新换了个坐姿，左脚往死里抵住脚踏板稳住身体。]]></one:T></one:OE>
