<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{161}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“4。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86车主似乎意识到了什么。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{163}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86车主似乎意识到了什么。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 尾灯猛地一闪，试图加速拉开。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{165}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[尾灯猛地一闪，试图加速拉开。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 后轮在雪地上打了轻微的滑。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{167}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[后轮在雪地上打了轻微的滑。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那一瞬间的失控，足够了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{169}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那一瞬间的失控，足够了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{171}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“3。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 左脚踩下离合。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{173}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[左脚踩下离合。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 右脚没有松油门。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{175}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[右脚没有松油门。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 这种操作在奥德赛上是疯狂的。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{177}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[这种操作在奥德赛上是疯狂的。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 但做到了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{179}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[但做到了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车身在雪地上划出弧线。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{181}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车身在雪地上划出弧线。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{183}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“2。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智身体被甩向左侧车门。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{185}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智身体被甩向左侧车门。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 太阳穴撞在车窗玻璃上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{187}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[太阳穴撞在车窗玻璃上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 闷响。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{189}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[闷响。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{191}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“操……”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 声音从牙缝挤出。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{193}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[声音从牙缝挤出。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “哥，你疯了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{195}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥，你疯了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一呼吸急促。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{197}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一呼吸急促。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 额头渗出薄汗。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{199}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[额头渗出薄汗。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 冷风灌进车窗后，汗水被瞬间冻住的刺痛感。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{201}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[冷风灌进车窗后，汗水被瞬间冻住的刺痛感。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{203}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“1。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛车头完全超越86前轮。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{205}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛车头完全超越86前轮。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 粉色跑车在后视镜里缩成光点。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{207}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[粉色跑车在后视镜里缩成光点。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{209}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“瓮……”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 猛地松开油门。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{211}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[猛地松开油门。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 发动机咆哮瞬间降低。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{213}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[发动机咆哮瞬间降低。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛在雪地上滑行十几米，缓缓停下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{215}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛在雪地上滑行十几米，缓缓停下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车厢只剩风扇嗡嗡声和两人喘息。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{217}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车厢只剩风扇嗡嗡声和两人喘息。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智太阳穴贴在车窗上，慢慢滑下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{219}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智太阳穴贴在车窗上，慢慢滑下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 眼睛还盯着后方。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{221}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[眼睛还盯着后方。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{223}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 声音有点哑。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{225}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[声音有点哑。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你刚才那一下……”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{227}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你刚才那一下……”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没有看他。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{229}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一没有看他。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 把白将军从指缝抽出，看一眼。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{231}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[把白将军从指缝抽出，看一眼。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 烟灰掉在方向盘上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{233}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[烟灰掉在方向盘上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “这大过年的。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{235}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“这大过年的。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 烟头弹出窗外。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{237}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[烟头弹出窗外。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “不至于。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{239}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“不至于。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智嘴角慢慢往上扬。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{241}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智嘴角慢慢往上扬。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 被打败之后又被点燃的表情。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{243}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[被打败之后又被点燃的表情。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “比藤原拓海还牛逼。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{245}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“比藤原拓海还牛逼。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没有接话。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{247}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一没有接话。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车窗摇上去一半。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{249}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车窗摇上去一半。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 冷风被挡在外面。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{251}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[冷风被挡在外面。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 雪花还在飘。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{253}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[雪花还在飘。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “走吧。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{440BE45B-1EE8-4979-9027-E872B8B24D95}{255}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“走吧。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 重新踩下油门。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{11}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[重新踩下油门。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛缓缓驶入霓虹更密集的街道。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{13}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛缓缓驶入霓虹更密集的街道。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 粉色86消失在雪雾里。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{15}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[粉色86消失在雪雾里。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 只剩两团红光在记忆里跳动。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{17}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[只剩两团红光在记忆里跳动。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智拿起杯架上的瑰夏冰美式。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{19}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智拿起杯架上的瑰夏冰美式。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 吸管被咬扁了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{21}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[吸管被咬扁了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 狠狠嘬一口。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{23}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[狠狠嘬一口。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 凉意直达胃部。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{25}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[凉意直达胃部。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{27}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 声音恢复平静。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{29}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[声音恢复平静。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那辆86车主刚才比了国际通用手势。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{31}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那辆86车主刚才比了国际通用手势。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一眼神没有变化。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{33}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一眼神没有变化。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那个小姐姐呢？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{35}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那个小姐姐呢？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智嘴角动了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{37}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智嘴角动了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “她也对你比了。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{39}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“她也对你比了。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 轻轻点头。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{41}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[轻轻点头。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那就好。” 他没有解释为什么好。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{43}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那就好。” 他没有解释为什么好。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智没有追问。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{45}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智没有追问。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛在雪夜继续前行。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{47}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛在雪夜继续前行。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车里音乐还在播放。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{49}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车里音乐还在播放。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 头文字D原声进入下一首。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{51}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[头文字D原声进入下一首。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 《Running in the 90's》。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{53}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[《Running in the 90's》。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智看着窗外霓虹和雪花。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{55}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智看着窗外霓虹和雪花。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 手指在安全带上轻轻摩挲。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{57}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[手指在安全带上轻轻摩挲。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 红印还在。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{59}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[红印还在。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{61}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 突然开口。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{63}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[突然开口。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你那个不用的老车。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{65}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你那个不用的老车。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一手指在方向盘上停了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{67}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一手指在方向盘上停了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “借我开开练练手。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{69}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“借我开开练练手。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 声音很轻。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{71}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[声音很轻。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 像在试探什么。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{73}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[像在试探什么。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 眼睛盯着前方的路。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{75}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[眼睛盯着前方的路。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 雪花在车灯下飞舞。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{77}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[雪花在车灯下飞舞。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “明天除夕。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{79}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“明天除夕。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 声音突然响起。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{81}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[声音突然响起。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “你要是不想回宿舍。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{83}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“你要是不想回宿舍。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 顿了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{85}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[顿了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那辆老车的钥匙在家里抽屉第二层。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{87}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那辆老车的钥匙在家里抽屉第二层。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智眼睛亮了一下。 亮光不是因为钥匙。 那句话后面还有东西。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{89}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智眼睛亮了一下。 亮光不是因为钥匙。 那句话后面还有东西。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “但是。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{91}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“但是。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 声音很平。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{93}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[声音很平。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “别用半热熔轮胎。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{95}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“别用半热熔轮胎。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智嘴角慢慢往上扬。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{97}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智嘴角慢慢往上扬。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 这一次是真的笑了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{99}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[这一次是真的笑了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “知道了，哥。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{101}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“知道了，哥。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛车灯在雪夜划出白色轨迹。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{103}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛车灯在雪夜划出白色轨迹。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 粉色86早已消失在霓虹深处。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{105}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[粉色86早已消失在霓虹深处。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那场短暂追逐刻进了这条雪夜街道。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{107}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那场短暂追逐刻进了这条雪夜街道。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智手指在杯子上轻敲一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{109}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智手指在杯子上轻敲一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 冰美式凉意还在胃里， 他没有再喝。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{111}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[冰美式凉意还在胃里， 他没有再喝。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 把杯子放回杯架。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{113}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[把杯子放回杯架。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{115}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 声音很轻。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{117}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[声音很轻。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “明天除夕。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{119}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“明天除夕。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 眼神没有变化。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{121}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[眼神没有变化。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{123}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“嗯。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那辆老车。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{125}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那辆老车。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 声音停了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{127}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[声音停了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “我可以开吗？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{129}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“我可以开吗？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 右手在方向盘上轻轻握紧。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{131}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[右手在方向盘上轻轻握紧。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 手指没有发白。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{133}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[手指没有发白。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 指节皮肤在冷风中微微发红。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{135}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[指节皮肤在冷风中微微发红。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “可以。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{137}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“可以。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 这两个字带着不容置疑的重量。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{139}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[这两个字带着不容置疑的重量。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智没有再说话。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{141}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智没有再说话。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 安全带又往下拉了一点。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{143}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[安全带又往下拉了一点。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛在雪夜继续前行。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{145}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛在雪夜继续前行。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 霓虹在车窗投下五颜六色光斑。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{147}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[霓虹在车窗投下五颜六色光斑。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 《Running in the 90's》还在播放。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{149}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[《Running in the 90's》还在播放。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 眼睛盯着前方的路。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{151}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[眼睛盯着前方的路。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 呼吸平稳了下来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{153}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[呼吸平稳了下来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 心跳还没有。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{155}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[心跳还没有。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 车停在红绿灯前。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{157}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[车停在红绿灯前。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 粉色86就在左侧车道， 车身静止不动。
