paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{159}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[粉色86就在左侧车道， 车身静止不动。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 静静停在那里，像被打败的花蝴蝶。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{161}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[静静停在那里，像被打败的花蝴蝶。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智眼睛亮了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{163}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智眼睛亮了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 那亮光不是因为胜利， 那是那一瞬间的确认。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{165}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[那亮光不是因为胜利， 那是那一瞬间的确认。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{167}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 声音很轻。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{169}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[声音很轻。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “他在看你。” 侯天一没有回头。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{171}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“他在看你。” 侯天一没有回头。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 眼睛盯着前方红绿灯。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{173}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[眼睛盯着前方红绿灯。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{175}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“嗯。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那小姐姐呢？”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{177}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那小姐姐呢？”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 嘴角动了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{179}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[嘴角动了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “她也在看。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{181}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“她也在看。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 嘴角慢慢往上扬。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{183}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[嘴角慢慢往上扬。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 这一次是真的笑了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{185}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[这一次是真的笑了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 红绿灯开始倒计时。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{187}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[红绿灯开始倒计时。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{189}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“9。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{191}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“8。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{193}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“7。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 手指在安全带上轻轻摩挲。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{195}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[手指在安全带上轻轻摩挲。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 红印还在。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{197}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[红印还在。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{199}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“6。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 眼神没有变化。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{201}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[眼神没有变化。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{203}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“5。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 呼吸有点急促。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{205}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[呼吸有点急促。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{207}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“4。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛发动机低沉咆哮。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{209}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛发动机低沉咆哮。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{211}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“3。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 粉色86尾灯猛地一闪， 车身仍然静止。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{213}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[粉色86尾灯猛地一闪， 车身仍然静止。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 静静停在那里。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{215}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[静静停在那里。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{217}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“2。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 右脚轻轻压在油门上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{219}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[右脚轻轻压在油门上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{221}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“1。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 绿灯亮了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{223}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯亮了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛缓缓驶入霓虹更密集街道。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{225}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛缓缓驶入霓虹更密集街道。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 粉色86还在原地， 它没有追上来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{227}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[粉色86还在原地， 它没有追上来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 眼睛盯着后视镜。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{229}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[眼睛盯着后视镜。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 两团红光在雪雾里慢慢变小。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{231}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[两团红光在雪雾里慢慢变小。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 直到消失。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{233}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[直到消失。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{235}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“哥。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 声音恢复平静。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{237}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[声音恢复平静。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “明天除夕。” 侯天一没有回答。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{239}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“明天除夕。” 侯天一没有回答。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 眼睛盯着前方路。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{241}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[眼睛盯着前方路。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 雪花在车灯下飞舞。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{243}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[雪花在车灯下飞舞。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “那辆老车的钥匙。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{245}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“那辆老车的钥匙。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 声音很轻。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{247}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[声音很轻。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “在家里抽屉第二层。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{249}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“在家里抽屉第二层。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 手指在方向盘上轻轻敲了一下。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{251}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[手指在方向盘上轻轻敲了一下。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: “可以。”
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{253}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[“可以。”]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 这两个字带着不容置疑的重量。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{48B52638-5542-4F7B-8E67-0C83E90E4EEF}{255}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[这两个字带着不容置疑的重量。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智没有再说话。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{B19A76AC-9E35-4A55-B799-2A2255BFD8CC}{11}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智没有再说话。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 安全带又往下拉了一点。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{B19A76AC-9E35-4A55-B799-2A2255BFD8CC}{13}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[安全带又往下拉了一点。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 奥德赛在雪夜继续前行。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{B19A76AC-9E35-4A55-B799-2A2255BFD8CC}{15}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[奥德赛在雪夜继续前行。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 霓虹灯在车窗投下光斑。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{B19A76AC-9E35-4A55-B799-2A2255BFD8CC}{17}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[霓虹灯在车窗投下光斑。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 《Running in the 90's》还在播放。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{B19A76AC-9E35-4A55-B799-2A2255BFD8CC}{19}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[《Running in the 90's》还在播放。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 眼睛盯着前方的路。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{B19A76AC-9E35-4A55-B799-2A2255BFD8CC}{21}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[眼睛盯着前方的路。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 呼吸平稳了下来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{B19A76AC-9E35-4A55-B799-2A2255BFD8CC}{23}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[呼吸平稳了下来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 心跳还没有。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:28:55.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:29:30.000Z" objectID="{B19A76AC-9E35-4A55-B799-2A2255BFD8CC}{25}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" lang="zh-CN" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[心跳还没有。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 绿灯亮了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{120}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[绿灯亮了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{122}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一右脚猛地踏下油门，奥德赛的车身往前蹿了一下。小智的后脑勺直接磕在了头枕上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{124}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一右脚猛地踏下油门，奥德赛的车身往前蹿了一下。小智的后脑勺直接磕在了头枕上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{126}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "嗡——"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{128}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["嗡——"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{130}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 丰田86几乎是同一时间弹射出去，粉色的车身在雪夜里拉出一道模糊的影子。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{132}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[丰田86几乎是同一时间弹射出去，粉色的车身在雪夜里拉出一道模糊的影子。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{134}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一盯着86的尾灯，嘴角往上挑了挑。奥德赛的涡轮迟滞了半秒才接上力，但发动机舱里那台2.4升机器还是把整辆车往前推了出去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{136}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一盯着86的尾灯，嘴角往上挑了挑。奥德赛的涡轮迟滞了半秒才接上力，但发动机舱里那台2.4升机器还是把整辆车往前推了出去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{138}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "哥，你疯了吧！"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{140}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["哥，你疯了吧！"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{142}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智的声音都劈了。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{144}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智的声音都劈了。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{146}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一没搭理他，左手握着方向盘，右手在挡把上推了一下。转速表的指针往上蹦了一格。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{148}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一没搭理他，左手握着方向盘，右手在挡把上推了一下。转速表的指针往上蹦了一格。]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 86在前面拐进了右转车道。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{152}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[86在前面拐进了右转车道。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{154}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一跟着打了把方向，奥德赛的底盘发出一声沉闷的响。雪天的路面上轮胎抓地力本来就弱，这一把方向差点让车尾甩出去。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{156}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一跟着打了把方向，奥德赛的底盘发出一声沉闷的响。雪天的路面上轮胎抓地力本来就弱，这一把方向差点让车尾甩出去。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{158}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "操，哥，你慢点，这车侧滑！"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{160}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["操，哥，你慢点，这车侧滑！"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{162}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "没事，奥德赛重心低。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{164}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["没事，奥德赛重心低。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{166}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 侯天一嘴里说着没事，脚底下却松了一点油门。前方86的刹车灯闪了两下，那台水平对置发动机的声浪隔着两层车窗还是钻了进来。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{168}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[侯天一嘴里说着没事，脚底下却松了一点油门。前方86的刹车灯闪了两下，那台水平对置发动机的声浪隔着两层车窗还是钻了进来。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{170}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智的手心全是汗，在裤缝上蹭了蹭。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{172}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智的手心全是汗，在裤缝上蹭了蹭。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{174}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "你紧张个啥，又没真要跟他跑。"侯天一瞥了一眼后视镜，确认后面没车跟上来，才把速度压到了六十。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{176}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["你紧张个啥，又没真要跟他跑。"侯天一瞥了一眼后视镜，确认后面没车跟上来，才把速度压到了六十。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{178}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "那你刚才搞那一出干啥？"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{180}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["那你刚才搞那一出干啥？"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{182}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: "看他不顺眼。"
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{184}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA["看他不顺眼。"]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{186}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 就这么一句话，侯天一把刚才那股劲儿全卸了。车里的音乐还在放着，是《Rage Your Dream》的前奏，鼓点一下一下敲在两个人的耳膜上。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{188}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[就这么一句话，侯天一把刚才那股劲儿全卸了。车里的音乐还在放着，是《Rage Your Dream》的前奏，鼓点一下一下敲在两个人的耳膜上。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{190}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 小智往座椅里靠了靠，偏头看了一眼侯天一的侧脸。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{192}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[小智往座椅里靠了靠，偏头看了一眼侯天一的侧脸。]]></one:T></one:OE>

<one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{194}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[]]></one:T></one:OE>

paragraphs.text: 灯光从车窗外一段一段地扫进来，把他哥的脸照得忽明忽暗。下巴上有点胡茬，眼睛还是死死盯着前面那台粉色86的屁股。
paragraphs.raw_oe_xml: <one:OE authorResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" lastModifiedByResolutionID="<resolutionId provider="Windows Live" hash="7VBB3R4Oxezz4dDLg1XDkQ=="><localId cid="a21b323b213f5cb7"/></resolutionId>" creationTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" lastModifiedTime="2026-09-21T18:18:26.000Z" objectID="{5BFF81A7-B509-42B1-BCFB-BE1FF16261BF}{196}{B0}" alignment="left" quickStyleIndex="1" xmlns:one="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/onenote/2013/onenote"><one:T><![CDATA[灯光从车窗外一段一段地扫进来，把他哥的脸照得忽明忽暗。下巴上有点胡茬，眼睛还是死死盯着前面那台粉色86的屁股。]]></one:T></one:OE>
